kjv: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

wlc: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלַי כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה אַרְבַּע פְּעָמִים וָאָשִׁיב אוֹתָם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה ׃
lxx: καὶ δόμοι λίθινοι τρεῖς, καὶ δόμος ξύλινος εἶς· καὶ ἡ δαπάνη ἐξ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως δοθήσεται.
vulg: miserunt autem ad me secundum verbum hoc per quattuor vices et respondi eis iuxta sermonem priorem
clem: Miserunt autem ad me secundum verbum hoc per quatuor vices: et respondi eis juxta sermonem priorem.
kjv: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

wlc: ס וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלַי סַנְבַלַּט כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה פַּעַם חֲמִישִׁית אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ וְאִגֶּרֶת פְּתוּחָה בְּיָדוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ τὰ σκεύη οἴκου θεοῦ τὰ ἀργυρᾶ καὶ τὰ χρυσᾶ, ἃ Ναβουχοδονοσὸρ ἐξήνεγκεν ἀπὸ οἴκου τοῦ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἐπὶ τόπου ἐτέθη ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ.
vulg: et misit ad me Sanaballat iuxta verbum prius quinta vice puerum suum et epistulam habebat in manu scriptam hoc modo
clem: Et misit ad me Sanaballat juxta verbum prius quinta vice puerum suum, et epistolam habebat in manu sua scriptam hoc modo:
kjv: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

wlc: כָּתוּב בָּהּ בַּגּוֹיִם נִשְׁמָע וְגַשְׁמוּ אֹמֵר אַתָּה וְהַיְּהוּדִים חֹשְׁבִים לִמְרוֹד עַל־כֵּן אַתָּה בוֹנֶה הַחוֹמָה וְאַתָּה הוֶֹה לָהֶם לְמֶלֶךְ כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה ׃
lxx: νῦν δώσετε, ἔπαρχοι πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ, Σαθαρβουζανὰ καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν Ἀφαρσαχαῖοι ἐν πέρα ποταμοῦ, μακρὰν ὄντες ἐκεῖθεν·
vulg: in gentibus auditum est et Gosem dixit quod tu et Iudaei cogitetis rebellare et propterea aedifices murum et levare te velis super eos regem propter quam causam
clem: In gentibus auditum est, et Gossem dixit, quod tu et Judi cogitetis rebellare, et propterea difices murum, et levare te velis super eos regem: propter quam causam
kjv: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

wlc: וְגַם־נְבִיאִים הֶעֱמַדְתָּ לִקְרֹא עָלֶיךָ בִירוּשָׁלַםִ לֵאמֹר מֶלֶךְ בִּיהוּדָה וְעַתָּה יִשָּׁמַע לַמֶּלֶךְ כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעַתָּה לְכָה וְנִוָּעֲצָה יַחְדָּו ׃ ס
lxx: ἄφετε τὸ ἔργον οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ· καὶ πρεσβύτεροι τῶν Ἰουδαίων οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκεῖνον οἰκοδομείτωσαν ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et prophetas posueris qui praedicent de te in Hierusalem dicentes rex in Iudaea est auditurus est rex verba haec idcirco nunc veni ut ineamus consilium pariter
clem: et prophetas posueris, qui prdicent de te in Jerusalem, dicentes: Rex in Juda est. Auditurus est rex verba hc: idcirco nunc veni, ut ineamus consilium pariter.
kjv: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

wlc: וָאֶשְׁלְחָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר לֹא נִהְיָה כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה אוֹמֵר כִּי מִלִּבְּךָ אַתָּה בוֹדָאם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ἐτέθη γνώμη μή ποτέ τι ποιήσητε μετὰ πρεσβυτέρων τῶν Ἰουδαίων τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκεῖνον· καὶ ἀπὸ ὑπαρχόντων βασιλέως τῶν φόρων πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐπιμελῶς δαπάνη ἔστω διδομένη τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐκείνοις, τὸ μὴ καταργηθῆναι·
vulg: et misi ad eos dicens non est factum secundum verba haec quae tu loqueris de corde enim tuo tu conponis haec
clem: Et misi ad eos, dicens: Non est factum secundum verba hc, qu tu loqueris: de corde enim tuo tu componis hc.
kjv: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

wlc: כִּי כֻלָּם מְיָרְאִים אוֹתָנוּ לֵאמֹר יִרְפּוּ יְדֵיהֶם מִן־הַמְּלָאכָה וְלֹא תֵעָשֶׂה וְעַתָּה חַזֵּק אֶת־יָדָי ׃
lxx: καὶ ὃ ἂν ὑστέρημα, καὶ υἱοὺς βοῶν καὶ κριῶν καὶ ἀμνοὺς εἰς ὁλοκαυτώσεις τῷ θεῷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, πυρούς, ἄλας, οἶνον, ἔλαιον, κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα ἱερέων τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἔστω διδόμενον αὐτοῖς ἡμέραν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὁ ἐὰν αἰτήσωσιν,
vulg: omnes autem hii terrebant nos cogitantes quod cessarent manus nostrae ab opere et quiesceremus quam ob causam magis confortavi manus meas
clem: Omnes enim hi terrebant nos, cogitantes quod cessarent manus nostr ab opere, et quiesceremus: quam ob causam magis confortavi manus meas.
kjv: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.

wlc: וַאֲנִי־בָאתִי בֵּית שְׁמַעְיָה בֶן־דְּלָיָה בֶּן־מְהֵיטַבְאֵל וְהוּא עָצוּר וַיֹּאמֶר נִוָּעֵד אֶל־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַהֵיכָל וְנִסְגְּרָה דַּלְתוֹת הַהֵיכָל כִּי בָּאִים לְהָרְגֶךָ וְלַיְלָה בָּאִים לְהָרְגֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἵνα ὦσιν προσφέροντες εὐωδίας τῷ θεῷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ προσεύχωνται εἰς ζωὴν τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ υἱῶν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et ingressus sum domum Samaiae filii Dalaiae filii Metabehel secreto qui ait tractemus nobiscum in domo Dei in medio templi et claudamus portas aedis quia venturi sunt ut interficiant te et nocte venturi sunt ad occidendum te
clem: Et ingressus sum domum Semai filii Dalai filii Metabeel secreto. Qui ait: Tractemus nobiscum in domo Dei in medio templi, et claudamus portas dis: quia venturi sunt ut interficiant te, et nocte venturi sunt ad occidendum te.
kjv: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

wlc: וָאֹמְרָה הַאִישׁ כָּמוֹנִי יִבְרָח וּמִי כָמוֹנִי אֲשֶׁר־יָבוֹא אֶל־הַהֵיכָל וָחָי לֹא אָבוֹא ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ἐτέθη γνώμη ὅτι πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἀλλάξει τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο, καὶ καθαιρεθήσεται ξύλον ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ὠρθωμένος πληγήσεται ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὁ οἶκος αὐτοῦ τὸ κατʼ ἐμέ ποιηθήσεται.
vulg: et dixi num quisquam similis mei fugit et quis ut ego ingredietur templum et vivet non ingrediar
clem: Et dixi: Num quisquam similis mei fugit? et quis ut ego ingredietur templum, et vivet? non ingrediar.
kjv: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

wlc: וָאַכִּירָה וְהִנֵּה לֹא־אֱלֹהִים שְׁלָחוֹ כִּי הַנְּבוּאָה דִּבֶּר עָלַי וְטוֹבִיָּה וְסַנְבַלַּט שְׂכָרוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ὁ θεὸς οὗ κατασκηνοῖ τὸ ὄνομα ἐκεῖ καταστρέψει πάντα βασιλέα καὶ λαὸν ὃς ἐκτενεῖ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἀλλάξαι ἢ ἀφανίσαι οἶκον θεοῦ τὸν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ. ἐγὼ Δαρεῖος ἔθηκα γνώμην, ἐπιμελῶς ἔσται.
vulg: et intellexi quod Deus non misisset eum sed quasi vaticinans locutus esset ad me et Tobia et Sanaballat conduxissent eum
clem: Et intellexi quod Deus non misisset eum, sed quasi vaticinans locutus esset ad me, et Tobias et Sanaballat conduxissent eum.
kjv: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

wlc: לְמַעַן שָׂכוּר הוּא לְמַעַן־אִירָא וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־כֵּן וְחָטָאתִי וְהָיָה לָהֶם לְשֵׁם רָע לְמַעַן יְחָרְפוּנִי ׃ פ
lxx: Τότε Γανθαναὶ ἔπαρχος πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ, Σαθαρβουζὰν καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃ ἀπέστειλεν Δαρεῖος ὁ βασιλεύς, οὕτως ἐπιμελῶς ἐποίησαν.
vulg: acceperat enim pretium ut territus facerem et peccarem et haberent malum quod exprobrarent mihi
clem: Acceperat enim pretium, ut territus facerem, et peccarem, et haberent malum quod exprobrarent mihi.
kjv: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

wlc: זָכְרָה אֱלֹהַי לְטוֹבִיָּה וּלְסַנְבַלַּט כְּמַעֲשָׂיו אֵלֶּה וְגַם לְנוֹעַדְיָה הַנְּבִיאָה וּלְיֶתֶר הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ מְיָרְאִים אוֹתִי ׃
lxx: καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τῶν Ἰουδαίων οἰκοδομοῦσιν καὶ οἰ Λευεῖται ἐν προφητείᾳ Ἁγγαίου τοῦ προφήτου καὶ Ζαχαρίου υἱοῦ Ἀδώ· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν καὶ κατηρτίσαντο ἀπὸ γνώμης θεοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἀπὸ γνώμης Κύρου καὶ Δαρείου καὶ Ἀσταρθὰ βασιλέων Περσῶν.
vulg: memento Domine mei pro Tobia et Sanaballat iuxta opera eorum talia sed et Noadiae prophetae et ceterorum prophetarum qui terrebant me
clem: Memento mei, Domine, pro Tobia et Sanaballat, juxta opera eorum talia: sed et Noadi prophet, et ceterorum prophetarum, qui terrebant me.
kjv: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

wlc: וַתִּשְׁלַם הַחוֹמָה בְּעֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה לֶאֱלוּל לַחֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנַיִם יוֹם ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐτέλεσαν τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον ἕως ἡμέρας τρίτης μηνὸς Ἀδάρ, ὅς ἐστιν ἔτος ἕκτον τῇ βασιλείᾳ Δαρείου τοῦ βασιλέως.
vulg: conpletus est autem murus vicesimo quinto die mensis elul quinquaginta duobus diebus
clem: Completus est autem murus vigesimo quinto die mensis Elul, quinquaginta duobus diebus.
kjv: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

wlc: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ כָּל־אוֹיְבֵינוּ וַיִּרְאוּ כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ מְאֹד בְּעֵינֵיהֶם וַיֵּדְעוּ כִּי מֵאֵת אֱלֹהֵינוּ נֶעֶשְׂתָה הַמְּלָאכָה הַזֹּאת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ, οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι υἱῶν ἀποικεσίας, ἐνκαίνια τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ.
vulg: factum est ergo cum audissent omnes inimici nostri ut timerent universae gentes quae erant in circuitu nostro et conciderent intra semet ipsos et scirent quod a Deo factum esset opus hoc
clem: Factum est ergo cum audissent omnes inimici nostri, ut timerent univers gentes qu erant in circuitu nostro, et conciderent intra semetipsos, et scirent quod a Deo factum esset opus hoc.
kjv: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

wlc: גַּם בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם מַרְבִּים חֹרֵי יְהוּדָה אִגְּרֹתֵיהֶם הוֹלְכוֹת עַל־טוֹבִיָּה וַאֲשֶׁר לְטוֹבִיָּה בָּאוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ προσήνεγκαν εἰς τὰ ἐνκαίνια τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ μόσχους ἑκατόν, κριοὺς διακοσίους, ἀμνοὺς τετρακοσίους, χιμάρους αἰγῶν περὶ ἁμαρτίας ὑπέρ παντὸς Ἰσραὴλ δώδεκα, εἰς ἀριθμὸν φυλῶν Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: sed et in diebus illis multae optimatium Iudaeorum epistulae mittebantur ad Tobiam et a Tobia veniebant ad eos
clem: Sed et in diebus illis mult optimatum Judorum epistol mittebantur ad Tobiam, et a Tobia veniebant ad eos.
kjv: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.

wlc: כִּי־רַבִּים בִּיהוּדָה בַּעֲלֵי שְׁבוּעָה לוֹ כִּי־חָתָן הוּא לִשְׁכַנְיָה בֶן־אָרַח וִיהוֹחָנָן בְּנוֹ לָקַח אֶת־בַּת־מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן בֶּרֶכְיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔστησαν τοὺς ἱερεῖς ἐν διαιρέσει αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς Λευείτας ἐν μερισμοῖς αὐτῶν ἐπὶ δουλείᾳ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ, κατὰ τὴν γραφὴν βιβλίου Μωυσῆ.
vulg: multi enim erant in Iudaea habentes iuramentum eius quia gener erat Secheniae filii Orei et Iohanan filius eius acceperat filiam Mosollam filii Barachiae
clem: Multi enim erant in Juda habentes juramentum ejus, quia gener erat Secheni filii Area, et Johanan filius ejus acceperat filiam Mosollam filii Barachi:
kjv: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

wlc: גַּם טוֹבֹתָיו הָיוּ אֹמְרִים לְפָנַי וּדְבָרַי הָיוּ מוֹצִיאִים לוֹ אִגְּרוֹת שָׁלַח טוֹבִיָּה לְיָרְאֵנִי ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς ἀποικεσίας τὸ πάσχα τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου. 20ὅτι ἐκαθερίσθησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται, ἕως εἷς πάντες καθαροί· καὶ ἔσφαξαν τὸ πάσχα τοῖς πᾶσιν υἱοῖς τῆς ἀποικεσίας καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ ἑαυτοῖς.
vulg: sed et laudabant eum coram me et verba mea nuntiabant ei et Tobias mittebat epistulas ut terreret me
clem: sed et laudabant eum coram me, et verba mea nuntiabant ei: et Tobias mittebat epistolas ut terreret me.
kjv: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

lxx: καὶ ἔφαγον οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τὸ πάσχα, ἀπὸ τῆς ἀποικεσίας, καὶ πᾶς ὁ χωριζόμενος εἰς ἀκαθαρσίας ἐθνῶν τῆς γῆς πρὸς αὐτοὺς τοῦ ἐκζητῆσαι Κύριον θεὸν Ἰσραήλ.
καὶ ἐποίησαν τὴν ἑορτὴν τῶν ἀζύμων ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ, ὅτι εὔφρανεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν καρδία βασιλέως Ἀσσοὺρ ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς κραταιῶσαι τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐν ἔργοις οἴκου θεοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

wlc: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִבְנְתָה הַחוֹמָה וָאַעֲמִיד הַדְּלָתוֹת וַיִּפָּקְדוּ הַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַלְוִיִּם ׃
lxx: Καὶ μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ἐν βασιλείᾳ Ἀρθασεσθὰ βασιλέως Περσῶν ἀνέβη Ἔσρας υἱὸς Σαραίου υἱοῦ Ζαρείου υἱοῦ Ἑλκειὰ
vulg: postquam autem aedificatus est murus et posui valvas et recensui ianitores et cantores et Levitas
clem: Postquam autem dificatus est murus, et posui valvas, et recensui janitores, et cantores, et Levitas,
kjv: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

wlc: וָאֲצַוֶּה אֶת־חֲנָנִי אָחִי וְאֶת־חֲנַנְיָה שַׂר הַבִּירָה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם כִּי־הוּא כְּאִישׁ אֱמֶת וְיָרֵא אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים מֵרַבִּים ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Σαλοὺμ υἱοῦ Σαδδοὺκ υἱοῦ Ἀχειτὼβ
vulg: praecepi Aneni fratri meo et Ananiae principi domus de Hierusalem ipse enim quasi vir verax et timens Deum plus ceteris videbatur
clem: prcepi Hanani fratri meo, et Hanani principi domus de Jerusalem (ipse enim quasi vir verax et timens Deum plus ceteris videbatur),
kjv: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לֹא יִפָּתְחוּ שַׁעֲרֵי יְרוּשָׁלַםִ עַד־חֹם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְעַד הֵם עֹמְדִים יָגִיפוּ הַדְּלָתוֹת וֶאֱחֹזוּ וְהַעֲמֵיד מִשְׁמְרוֹת יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלַםִ אִישׁ בְּמִשְׁמָרוֹ וְאִישׁ נֶגֶד בֵּיתוֹ ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Σαμαρειὰ υἱοῦ Ἐσρειὰ υἱοῦ Μαρερὼθ
vulg: et dixi eis non aperiantur portae Hierusalem usque ad calorem solis cumque adhuc adsisterent clausae portae sunt et oppilatae et posui custodes de habitatoribus Hierusalem singulos per vices suas et unumquemque contra domum suam
clem: et dixi eis: Non aperiantur port Jerusalem usque ad calorem solis. Cumque adhuc assisterent, claus port sunt, et oppilat: et posui custodes de habitatoribus Jerusalem, singulos per vices suas, et unumquemque contra domum suam.
kjv: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.

wlc: וְהָעִיר רַחֲבַת יָדַיִם וּגְדוֹלָה וְהָעָם מְעַט בְּתוֹכָהּ וְאֵין בָּתִּים בְּנוּיִם ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Ζαραιὰ υἱοῦ Σαουιὰ υἱοῦ Βοκκεὶ
vulg: civitas autem erat lata nimis et grandis et populus parvus in medio eius et non erant domus aedificatae
clem: Civitas autem erat lata nimis et grandis, et populus parvus in medio ejus, et non erant domus dificat.
kjv: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.

wlc: וַיִּתֵּן אֱלֹהַי אֶל־לִבִּי וָאֶקְבְּצָה אֶת־הַחֹרִים וְאֶת־הַסְּגָנִים וְאֶת־הָעָם לְהִתְיַחֵשׂ וָאֶמְצָא סֵפֶר הַיַּחַשׂ הָעוֹלִים בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה וָאֶמְצָא כָּתוּב בּוֹ ׃ פ
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἀβεισοῦε υἱοῦ Φινεὲς υἱοῦ Ἐλεαζὰρ υἱοῦ Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἱερέως τοῦ πατρῴου.
vulg: dedit autem Deus in corde meo et congregavi optimates et magistratus et vulgum ut recenserem eos et inveni librum census eorum qui ascenderant primum et inventum est scriptum in eo
clem: Deus autem dedit in corde meo, et congregavi optimates, et magistratus, et vulgus, ut recenserem eos: et inveni librum census eorum qui ascenderant primum, et inventum est scriptum in eo.
kjv: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

wlc: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי הַמְּדִינָה הָעֹלִים מִשְּׁבִי הַגּוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיָּשׁוּבוּ לִירוּשָׁלִַם וְלִיהוּדָה אִישׁ לְעִירוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀνέβη ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος, καὶ αὐτὸς γραμματεὺς ταχὺς ἐν νόμῳ Μωυσῆ ὃν ἔδωκεν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς, ὅτι χεὶρ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐζήτει αὐτός.
vulg: isti filii provinciae qui ascenderunt de captivitate migrantium quos transtulerat Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis et reversi sunt in Hierusalem et in Iudaeam unusquisque in civitatem suam
clem: Isti filii provinci, qui ascenderunt de captivitate migrantium, quos transtulerat Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et reversi sunt in Jerusalem et in Judam, unusquisque in civitatem suam.
kjv: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;

wlc: הַבָּאִים עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶל יֵשׁוּעַ נְחֶמְיָה עֲזַרְיָה רַעַמְיָה נַחֲמָנִי מָרְדֳּכַי בִּלְשָׁן מִסְפֶּרֶת בִּגְוַי נְחוּם בַּעֲנָה מִסְפַּר אַנְשֵׁי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευειτῶν καὶ οἱ ἄδοντες καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ Ναθινεὶμ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐν ἔτει ἑβδόμῳ τῷ Ἀσαρθαθὰ τῷ βασιλεῖ
vulg: qui venerunt cum Zorobabel Hiesuae Neemias Azarias Raamias Naamni Mardocheus Belsar Mespharath Beggoai Naum Baana numerus virorum populi Israhel
clem: Qui venerunt cum Zorobabel, Josue, Nehemias, Azarias, Raamias, Nahamani, Mardochus, Belsam, Mespharath, Begoai, Nahum, Baana. Numerus virorum populi Isral:
kjv: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;

wlc: בְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ אַלְפַּיִם מֵאָה וְשִׁבְעִים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ, τοῦτο τὸ ἔτος ἕβδομον τῷ βασιλεῖ
vulg: filii Pharos duo milia centum septuaginta duo
clem: filii Pharos, duo millia centum septuaginta duo:
kjv: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

wlc: בְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃ ס
lxx: ὅτι ἐν μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πέμπτου ἤλθοσαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, ὅτι χεὶρ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἦν ἀγαθὴ ἐπʼ αὐτόν.
vulg: filii Saphatiae trecenti septuaginta duo
clem: filii Saphatia, trecenti septuaginta duo:
kjv: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

wlc: בְּנֵי אָרַח שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃
lxx: ὅτι Ἔσρας ἔδωκεν ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ζητῆσαι τὸν νόμον καὶ ποιεῖν καὶ διδάσκειν ἐν Ἰσραὴλ προστάγματα καὶ κρίμα.
vulg: filii Area sescenti quinquaginta duo
clem: filii Area, sexcenti quinquaginta duo:
kjv: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.

wlc: ס בְּנֵי־פַחַת מוֹאָב לִבְנֵי יֵשׁוּעַ וְיוֹאָב אַלְפַּיִם וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר ׃ ס
lxx: Καὶ αὕτη ἡ διασάφησις τοῦ διατάγματος οὗ ἔδωκεν Ἀσαρθαθὰ τῷ Ἔσρᾳ τῷ ἱερεῖ τῷ γραμματεῖ βιβλίου λόγων ἐντολῶν Κυρίου καὶ προσταγμάτων αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ
vulg: filii Phaethmoab filiorum Hiesuae et Ioab duo milia octingenti decem et octo
clem: filii Phahathmoab filiorum Josue et Joab, duo millia octingenti decem et octo:
kjv: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.

wlc: בְּנֵי עֵילָם אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָה ׃ ס
lxx: Ἀσαρθαθὰ βασιλεὺς βασιλέων Ἔσρᾳ γραμματεῖ νόμου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ. τετέλεστο λόγος καὶ ἡ ἀπόκρισις.
vulg: filii Helam mille octingenti quinquaginta quattuor
clem: filii lam, mille ducenti quinquaginta quatuor:
kjv: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

wlc: בְּנֵי זַתּוּא שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה ׃ ס
lxx: ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ἐτέθη γνώμη ὅτι πᾶς ἑκουσιαζόμενος ἐν βασιλείᾳ μου ἀπὸ λαοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἱερέων καὶ Λευειτῶν πορευθῆναι εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, μετὰ σοῦ πορευθῆναι.
vulg: filii Zethua octingenti quadraginta quinque
clem: filii Zethua, octingenti quadraginta quinque:
kjv: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.

wlc: בְּנֵי זַכָּי שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים ׃ ס
lxx: ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἑπτὰ συμβούλων ἀπεστάλη ἐπισκέψασθαι ἐπὶ τὴν Ἰουδαίαν καὶ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ νόμῳ θεοῦ αὐτῶν τῷ ἐν χειρί σου.
vulg: filii Zacchai septingenti sexaginta
clem: filii Zachai, septingenti sexaginta:
kjv: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

wlc: בְּנֵי בִנּוּי שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ὃ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ σύμβουλοι ἡκουσιάσθησαν τῷ κυρίῳ τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ τῷ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ κατασκηνοῦντι,
vulg: filii Bennui sescenti quadraginta octo
clem: filii Bannui, sexcenti quadraginta octo:
kjv: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.

wlc: בְּנֵי בֵבָי שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ πᾶν ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ὅ τι ἐὰν εὕρῃς ἐν πάσῃ χώρᾳ Βαβυλῶνος μετὰ ἑκουσιασμοῦ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἱερέων τῶν ἑκουσια ζομένων εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ τὸν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ·
vulg: filii Bebai sescenti viginti octo
clem: filii Bebai, sexcenti viginti octo:
kjv: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.

wlc: בְּנֵי עַזְגָּד אַלְפַּיִם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ πᾶν προσπορευομενον, τοῦτον ἑτοίμως ἔνταξον ἐν βιβλίῳ τούτῳ, μόσχους. κριούς. ἀμνούς, καὶ θυσίας αὐτῶν καὶ σπονδὰς αὐτῶν· καὶ προσοίσεις αὐτὰ ἐπὶ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: filii Azgad duo milia trecenti viginti duo
clem: filii Azgad, duo millia trecenti viginti duo:
kjv: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.

wlc: בְּנֵי אֲדֹנִיקָם שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וְשִׁבְעָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἔτι ἐπὶ σέ καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου ἠγαθύνθη ἐν καταλοίπῳ τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ τοῦ χρυσίου ποιῆσαι; ὡς ἀρεστὸν τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν ποιήσατε.
vulg: filii Adonicam sescenti sexaginta septem
clem: filii Adonicam, sexcenti sexaginta septem:
kjv: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.

wlc: בְּנֵי בִגְוָי אַלְפַּיִם שִׁשִּׁים וְשִׁבְעָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ τὰ σκεύη τὰ διδόμενά σοι εἰς λειτουργίαν οἴκου θεοῦ παράδος ἐνώπιον θεοῦ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: filii Baggoaim duo milia sexaginta septem
clem: filii Beguai, duo millia sexaginta septem:
kjv: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.

wlc: בְּנֵי עָדִין שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ κατάλοιπον χρείας οἴκου θεοῦ ὃ ἂν φανῇ σοι δοῦναι δώσεις ἀπὸ οἴκων γάζης βασιλέως.
vulg: filii Adin sescenti quinquaginta quinque
clem: filii Adin, sexcenti quinquaginta quinque:
kjv: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.

wlc: בְּנֵי־אָטֵר לְחִזְקִיָּה תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, ἔγωγ᾿ Ἀρσαρθαθὰ βασιλεὺς ἔθηκα γνώμην πάσαις ταῖς γάζαις ταῖς ἐν πέρα τοῦ ποταμοῦ, ὅτι πᾶν ὃ ἂν αἰτήσῃ ὑμᾶς Ἔσρας ὁ ἱερεὺς γραμματεὺς τοῦ νόμου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἑτοίμαως γινέσθω,
vulg: filii Ater filii Ezechiae nonaginta octo
clem: filii Ater, filii Hezeci, nonaginta octo:
kjv: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

wlc: בְּנֵי חָשֻׁם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
lxx: ἕως ἀργυρίου ταλάντων καὶ ἕως πυροῦ κόρων ἑκατόν, καὶ ἕως οἴνου ἀποθηκῶν ἑκατόν, καὶ ἄλας οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν γραφή.
vulg: filii Asem trecenti viginti octo
clem: filii Hasem, trecenti viginti octo:
kjv: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.

wlc: בְּנֵי בֵצָי שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה ׃ ס
lxx: πᾶν ὅ ἐστιν ἐν γνώμῃ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ γινέσθω. προσέχετε ἐπιχειρῆσαι μήτι εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, μή ποτε γένηται ὀργὴ ἐπὶ τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: filii Besai trecenti viginti quattuor
clem: filii Besai, trecenti viginti quatuor:
kjv: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.

wlc: בְּנֵי חָרִיף מֵאָה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ὑμῖν ἐγνώρισται ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς Λευείταις, ἄδουσιν, πυλωροῖς, Ναθεινεὶμ καὶ λειτουργοῖς οἴκου θεοῦ τούτου, φόρος μὴ ἔστω σοι· οὐκ ἐξουσιάσεις καταδουλοῦσθαι αὐτούς.
vulg: filii Areph centum duodecim
clem: filii Hareph, centum duodecim:
kjv: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

wlc: בְּנֵי גִבְעוֹן תִּשְׁעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ σύ, Ἔσρα, ᾧ ἡ σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν χειρί σου, κατάστησον γραμματεῖς καὶ κριτάς, ἴνα ὦσιν κρίνοντες παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τῷ ἐν πέρα τοῦ ποταμοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς εἰδόσιν νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ· καὶ τῷ μὴ εἰδότι γνωριεῖτε.
vulg: filii Gabaon nonaginta quinque
clem: filii Gabaon, nonaginta quinque:
kjv: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

wlc: אַנְשֵׁי בֵית־לֶחֶם וּנְטֹפָה מֵאָה שְׁמֹנִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἂν μὴ ἦ ποιῶν νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ νόμον τοῦ βασιλέως ἑτοίμως, τὸ κρίμα ἔσται γινόμενον ἐξ αὐτοῦ, ἐὰν εἰς θάνατον ἐὰν εἰς παιδείαν ἐὰν εἰς ζημίαν βίου ἐὰν εἰς παράδοσιν.
vulg: viri Bethleem et Netupha centum octoginta octo
clem: filii Bethlehem et Netupha, centum octoginta octo.
kjv: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.

wlc: אַנְשֵׁי עֲנָתוֹת מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
lxx: εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, ὃς ἔδωκεν οὕτως ἐν καρδίᾳ τοῦ βασιλέως, τοῦ δοξάσαντος οἶκον τὸν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ,
vulg: viri Anathoth centum viginti octo
clem: Viri Anathoth, centum viginti octo.
kjv: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

lxx: καὶ ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἔκλινεν ἔλεος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν συμβούλων αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντων τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ βασιλέως τῶν ἐπηρμένων. καὶ ἐγὼ ἐκραταιώθην ὡς χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡ ἀγαθὴ ἐπʼ ἐμέ, καὶ συνῆξα ἀπὸ Ἰσραὴλ ἄρχοντας ἀναβῆναι μετʼ ἐμοῦ.

clem: Viri Bethazmoth, quadraginta duo.
kjv: The men of Bethazmaveth, forty and two.

vulg: viri Cariathiarim Cephira et Beroth septingenti quadraginta tres
clem: Viri Cariathiarim, Cephira, et Beroth, septingenti quadraginta tres.

clem: Viri Rama et Geba, sexcenti viginti unus.

vulg: viri Machmas centum viginti duo
clem: Viri Machmas, centum viginti duo.
kjv: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.

wlc: אַנְשֵׁי בֵית־אֵל וְהָעָי מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה ׃ ס
vulg: viri Bethel et Hai centum viginti tres
clem: Viri Bethel et Hai, centum viginti tres.
kjv: The men of Bethel and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.

wlc: אַנְשֵׁי נְבוֹ אַחֵר חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃ ס
vulg: viri Nebo alterius quinquaginta duo
clem: Viri Nebo alterius, quinquaginta duo.
kjv: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

clem: Filii Harem, trecenti viginti.
kjv: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

vulg: filii Hiericho trecenti quadraginta quinque
clem: Filii Jericho, trecenti quadraginta quinque.
kjv: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

wlc: בְּנֵי־לֹד חָדִיד וְאוֹנוֹ שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים וְאֶחָד ׃ ס
vulg: filii Lod Adid et Ono septingenti viginti unus
clem: Filii Lod Hadid et Ono, septingenti viginti unus.
kjv: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.

wlc: בְּנֵי סְנָאָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים ׃ פ
vulg: filii Senaa tria milia nongenti triginta
clem: Filii Senaa, tria millia nongenti triginta.
kjv: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

wlc: הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי יְדַעְיָה לְבֵית יֵשׁוּעַ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה ׃ ס

clem: Sacerdotes: filii Idaia in domo Josue, nongenti septuaginta tres.
kjv: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

wlc: בְּנֵי אִמֵּר אֶלֶף חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃ ס
vulg: filii Emmer mille quinquaginta duo
clem: Filii Emmer, mille quinquaginta duo.
kjv: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

vulg: filii Phassur mille ducenti quadraginta septem
clem: Filii Phashur, mille ducenti quadraginta septem.
kjv: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

wlc: בְּנֵי חָרִם אֶלֶף שִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר ׃ פ
vulg: filii Arem mille decem et septem Levitae
clem: Filii Arem, mille decem et septem. Levit:
kjv: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

wlc: הַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־יֵשׁוּעַ לְקַדְמִיאֵל לִבְנֵי לְהוֹדְוָה שִׁבְעִים וְאַרְבָּעָה ׃ ס
vulg: filii Iosue et Cadmihel filiorum
clem: filii Josue et Cedmihel filiorum
kjv: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.

wlc: הַמְשֹׁרְרִים בְּנֵי אָסָף מֵאָה אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
vulg: Oduia septuaginta quattuor cantores
clem: Odui, septuaginta quatuor. Cantores:
kjv: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.

wlc: הַשֹּׁעֲרִים בְּנֵי־שַׁלּוּם בְּנֵי־אָטֵר בְּנֵי־טַלְמֹן בְּנֵי־עַקּוּב בְּנֵי חֲטִיטָא בְּנֵי שֹׁבָי מֵאָה שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃ ס
vulg: filii Asaph centum quadraginta octo
clem: filii Asaph, centum quadraginta octo.
kjv: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.

wlc: הַנְּתִינִים בְּנֵי־צִחָא בְנֵי־חֲשֻׂפָא בְּנֵי טַבָּעוֹת ׃
vulg: ianitores filii Sellum filii Ater filii Telmon filii Accub filii Atita filii Sobai centum triginta octo
clem: Janitores: filii Sellum, filii Ater, filii Telmon, filii Accub, filii Hatita, filii Sobai: centum triginta octo.
kjv: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

wlc: בְּנֵי־קֵירֹס בְּנֵי־סִיעָא בְּנֵי פָדוֹן ׃
vulg: Nathinnei filii Soa filii Asfa filii Tebaoth
clem: Nathini: filii Soha, filii Hasupha, filii Tebbaoth,
kjv: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

wlc: בְּנֵי־לְבָנָה בְנֵי־חֲגָבָה בְּנֵי שַׁלְמָי ׃
vulg: filii Ceros filii Siaa filii Fado filii Lebana filii Agaba filii Selmon
clem: filii Ceros, filii Siaa, filii Phadon, filii Lebana, filii Hagaba, filii Selmai,
kjv: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,

wlc: בְּנֵי־חָנָן בְּנֵי־גִדֵּל בְּנֵי־גָחַר ׃
vulg: filii Anan filii Geddel filii Gaer
clem: filii Hanan, filii Geddel, filii Gaher,
kjv: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

wlc: בְּנֵי־רְאָיָה בְנֵי־רְצִין בְּנֵי נְקוֹדָא ׃
vulg: filii Raaia filii Rasim filii Necoda
clem: filii Raaia, filii Rasin, filii Necoda,
kjv: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

wlc: בְּנֵי־גַזָּם בְּנֵי־עֻזָּא בְּנֵי פָסֵחַ ׃
vulg: filii Gezem filii Aza filii Fasea
clem: filii Gezem, filii Aza, filii Phasea,
kjv: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,

wlc: בְּנֵי־בֵסַי בְּנֵי־מְעוּנִים בְּנֵי נְפוּשְׁסִים ׃
vulg: filii Besai filii Munim filii Nephusim
clem: filii Besai, filii Munim, filii Nephussim,
kjv: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

wlc: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּוּק בְּנֵי־חֲקוּפָא בְּנֵי חַרְחוּר ׃
vulg: filii Becbuc filii Acupha filii Arur
clem: filii Bacbuc, filii Hacupha, filii Harhur,
kjv: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

wlc: בְּנֵי־בַצְלִית בְּנֵי־מְחִידָא בְּנֵי חַרְשָׁא ׃
vulg: filii Besloth filii Meida filii Arsa
clem: filii Besloth, filii Mahida, filii Harsa,
kjv: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

wlc: בְּנֵי־בַרְקוֹס בְּנֵי־סִיסְרָא בְּנֵי־תָמַח ׃
vulg: filii Bercos filii Sisara filii Thema
clem: filii Bercos, filii Sisara, filii Thema,
kjv: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,

wlc: בְּנֵי נְצִיחַ בְּנֵי חֲטִיפָא ׃
vulg: filii Nesia filii Atipha
clem: filii Nasia, filii Hatipha,
kjv: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

wlc: בְּנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בְּנֵי־סוֹטַי בְּנֵי־סוֹפֶרֶת בְּנֵי פְרִידָא ׃
vulg: filii servorum Salomonis filii Sotai filii Sophereth filii Pherida
clem: filii servorum Salomonis, filii Sothai, filii Sophereth, filii Pharida,
kjv: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

wlc: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָא בְנֵי־דַרְקוֹן בְּנֵי גִדֵּל ׃
vulg: filii Iahala filii Dercon filii Geddel
clem: filii Jahala, filii Darcon, filii Jeddel,
kjv: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

wlc: בְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה בְנֵי־חַטִּיל בְּנֵי פֹּכֶרֶת הַצְּבָיִים בְּנֵי אָמוֹן ׃
vulg: filii Saphatia filii Athil filii Phocereth qui erat ortus ex Sabaim filio Amon
clem: filii Saphatia, filii Hatil, filii Phochereth, qui erat ortus ex Sabaim filio Amon.
kjv: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.

wlc: כָּל־הַנְּתִינִים וּבְנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃ פ
vulg: omnes Nathinnei et filii servorum Salomonis trecenti nonaginta duo
clem: Omnes Nathini, et filii servorum Salomonis, trecenti nonaginta duo.
kjv: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה הָעוֹלִים מִתֵּל מֶלַח תֵּל חַרְשָׁא כְּרוּב אַדּוֹן וְאִמֵּר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם וְזַרְעָם אִם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵם ׃
vulg: hii sunt autem qui ascenderunt de Thelmella Thelarsa Cherub Addon et Emmer et non potuerunt indicare domum patrum suorum et semen suum utrum ex Israhel essent
clem: Hi sunt autem qui ascenderunt de Thelmela, Thelharsa, Cherub, Addon, et Emmer: et non potuerunt indicare domum patrum suorum, et semen suum, utrum ex Isral essent,
kjv: And these were they which went up also from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.

wlc: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָה בְנֵי־טוֹבִיָּה בְּנֵי נְקוֹדָא שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃ ס
vulg: filii Dalaia filii Tobia filii Necoda sescenti quadraginta duo
clem: filii Dalaia, filii Tobia, filii Necoda, sexcenti quadraginta duo.
kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.

wlc: וּמִן־הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי חֳבַיָּה בְּנֵי הַקּוֹץ בְּנֵי בַרְזִלַּי אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִבְּנוֹת בַּרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי אִשָּׁה וַיִּקָּרֵא עַל־שְׁמָם ׃
vulg: et de sacerdotibus filii Abia filii Accos filii Berzellai qui accepit de filiabus Berzellai Galaditis uxorem et vocatus est nomine eorum
clem: Et de sacerdotibus, filii Habia, filii Accos, filii Berzellai, qui accepit de filiabus Berzellai Galaaditis uxorem, et vocatus est nomine eorum.
kjv: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

wlc: אֵלֶּה בִּקְשׁוּ כְתָבָם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂים וְלֹא נִמְצָא וַיְגֹאֲלוּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּה ׃
vulg: hii quaesierunt scripturam suam in censu et non invenerunt et eiecti sunt de sacerdotio
clem: Hi qusierunt scripturam suam in censu, et non invenerunt: et ejecti sunt de sacerdotio.
kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁתָא לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאכְלוּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים עַד עֲמֹד הַכֹּהֵן לְאוּרִים וְתוּמִּים ׃
vulg: dixitque Athersatha eis ut non manducarent de sanctis sanctorum donec staret sacerdos doctus et eruditus
clem: Dixitque Athersatha eis ut non manducarent de Sanctis sanctorum, donec staret sacerdos doctus et eruditus.
kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

wlc: כָּל־הַקָּהָל כְּאֶחָד אַרְבַּע רִבּוֹא אַלְפַּיִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים ׃
vulg: omnis multitudo quasi unus quadraginta duo milia sescenti sexaginta
clem: Omnis multitudo quasi vir unus quadraginta duo millia trecenti sexaginta,
kjv: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

wlc: מִלְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶם וְאַמְהֹתֵיהֶם אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָה וְלָהֶם מְשֹׁרֲרִים וּמְשֹׁרֲרוֹת מָאתַיִם וְאַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה ׃ ס
vulg: absque servis et ancillis eorum qui erant septem milia trecenti triginta et septem et inter eos cantores et cantrices ducentae quadraginta quinque
clem: absque servis et ancillis eorum, qui erant septem millia trecenti triginta septem, et inter eos cantores et cantatrices, ducenti quadraginta quinque.
kjv: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.

wlc: גְּמַלִּים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה ס חֲמֹרִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים ׃
clem: Equi eorum, septingenti triginta sex: muli eorum, ducenti quadraginta quinque:
kjv: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

wlc: וּמִקְצָת רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת נָתְנוּ לַמְּלָאכָה הַתִּרְשָׁתָא נָתַן לָאוֹצָר זָהָב דַּרְכְּמֹנִים אֶלֶף מִזְרָקוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים כָּתְנוֹת כֹּהֲנִים שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת ׃
vulg: cameli quadringenti triginta quinque asini sex milia septingenti viginti
clem: cameli eorum, quadringenti triginta quinque: asini, sex millia septingenti viginti.
kjv: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

wlc: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת נָתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר הַמְּלָאכָה זָהָב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים שְׁתֵּי רִבּוֹת וְכֶסֶף מָנִים אַלְפַּיִם וּמָאתָיִם ׃
vulg: nonnulli autem de principibus familiarum dederunt in opus Athersatha dedit in thesaurum auri dragmas mille fialas quinquaginta tunicas sacerdotales quingentas triginta
clem: Nonnulli autem de principibus familiarum dederunt in opus. Athersatha dedit in thesaurum auri drachmas mille, phialas quinquaginta, tunicas sacerdotales quingentas triginta.
kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.

wlc: וַאֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ שְׁאֵרִית הָעָם זָהָב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים שְׁתֵּי רִבּוֹא וְכֶסֶף מָנִים אַלְפָּיִם וְכָתְנֹת כֹּהֲנִים שִׁשִּׁים וְשִׁבְעָה ׃ פ
vulg: et de principibus familiarum dederunt in thesaurum operis auri dragmas viginti milia et argenti minas duo milia ducentas
clem: Et de principibus familiarum dederunt in thesaurum operis, auri drachmas viginti millia, et argenti mnas duo millia ducentas.
kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.

wlc: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וּמִן־הָעָם וְהַנְּתִינִים וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעָרֵיהֶם וַיִּגַּע הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעָרֵיהֶם ׃
vulg: et quod dedit reliquus populus auri dragmas viginti milia et argenti minas duo milia et tunicas sacerdotales sexaginta septem
clem: Et quod dedit reliquus populus, auri drachmas viginti millia, et argenti mnas duo millia, et tunicas sacerdotales sexaginta septem.
kjv: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.

vulg: habitaverunt autem sacerdotes et Levitae et ianitores et cantores et reliquum vulgus et Nathinnei et omnis Israhel in civitatibus suis
clem: Habitaverunt autem sacerdotes, et Levit, et janitores, et cantores, et reliquum vulgus, et Nathini, et omnis Isral, in civitatibus suis.
kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.

wlc: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ כָל־הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־הָרְחוֹב אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי שַׁעַר־הַמָּיִם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְעֶזְרָא הַסֹּפֵר לְהָבִיא אֶת־סֵפֶר תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: Καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες πατριῶν αὐτῶν, οἱ ὁδηγοὶ ἀναβαίνοντες μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐν βασιλείᾳ Ἀρθασθὰ τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος.
vulg: et venerat mensis septimus filii autem Israhel erant in civitatibus suis congregatusque est omnis populus quasi vir unus ad plateam quae est ante portam Aquarum et dixerunt Ezrae scribae ut adferret librum legis Mosi quam praecepit Dominus Israheli
clem: Et venerat mensis septimus: filii autem Isral erant in civitatibus suis. Congregatusque est omnis populus quasi vir unus ad plateam qu est ante portam aquarum: et dixerunt Esdr scrib ut afferret librum legis Moysi, quam prceperat Dominus Israli.
kjv: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded to Israel.

wlc: וַיָּבִיא עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה לִפְנֵי הַקָּהָל מֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה וְכֹל מֵבִין לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φεινεές, Ιηρσώμ· ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰθαμάρ, Δανιὴλ· ἀπὸ υἱῶν Δαυείδ, Γούς·
vulg: adtulit ergo Ezras sacerdos legem coram multitudine virorum et mulierum cunctisque qui poterant intellegere in die prima mensis septimi
clem: Attulit ergo Esdras sacerdos legem coram multitudine virorum et mulierum, cunctisque qui poterant intelligere, in die prima mensis septimi.
kjv: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

wlc: וַיִּקְרָא־בוֹ לִפְנֵי הָרְחוֹב אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי שַׁעַר־הַמַּיִם מִן־הָאוֹר עַד־מַחֲצִית הַיּוֹם נֶגֶד הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְהַמְּבִינִים וְאָזְנֵי כָל־הָעָם אֶל־סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Σαναχιὰ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φορός, Ζαχαρίας, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ τὸ σύστρεμμα ἑκατὸν καὶ πεντήκοντα·
vulg: et legit in eo aperte in platea quae erat ante portam Aquarum de mane usque ad mediam diem in conspectu virorum et mulierum et sapientium et aures omnis populi erant erectae ad librum
clem: Et legit in eo aperte in platea qu erat ante portam aquarum, de mane usque ad mediam diem, in conspectu virorum et mulierum, et sapientium: et aures omnis populi erant erect ad librum.
kjv: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

wlc: וַיַּעֲמֹד עֶזְרָא הַסֹּפֵר עַל־מִגְדַּל־עֵץ אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לַדָּבָר וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶצְלוֹ מַתִּתְיָה וְשֶׁמַע וַעֲנָיָה וְאוּרִיָּה וְחִלְקִיָּה וּמַעֲשֵׂיָה עַל־יְמִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ פְּדָיָה וּמִישָׁאֵל וּמַלְכִּיָּה וְחָשֻׁם וְחַשְׁבַּדָּנָה זְכַרְיָה מְשֻׁלָּם ׃ פ
lxx: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φααθμωάβ, Ἐλιανὰ υἱὸς Ζαρειά, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: stetit autem Ezras scriba super gradum ligneum quem fecerat ad loquendum et steterunt iuxta eum Matthathia et Sema et Ania et Uria et Helcia et Maasia ad dextram eius et ad sinistram Phadaia Misahel et Melchia et Asum et Asephdana Zaccharia et Mosollam
clem: Stetit autem Esdras scriba super gradum ligneum, quem fecerat ad loquendum: et steterunt juxta eum Mathathias, et Semeia, et Ania, et Uria, et Helcia, et Maasia, ad dexteram ejus: et ad sinistram, Phadaia, Misal, et Melchia, et Hasum, et Hasbadana, Zacharia, et Mosollam.
kjv: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

wlc: וַיִּפְתַּח עֶזְרָא הַסֵּפֶר לְעֵינֵי כָל־הָעָם כִּי־מֵעַל כָּל־הָעָם הָיָה וּכְפִתְחוֹ עָמְדוּ כָל־הָעָם ׃
vulg: et aperuit Ezras librum coram omni populo super universum quippe populum eminebat et cum aperuisset eum stetit omnis populus
clem: Et aperuit Esdras librum coram omni populo: super universum quippe populum eminebat: et cum aperuisset eum, stetit omnis populus.
kjv: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

wlc: וַיְבָרֶךְ עֶזְרָא אֶת־יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים הַגָּדוֹל וַיַּעֲנוּ כָל־הָעָם אָמֵן אָמֵן בְּמֹעַל יְדֵיהֶם וַיִּקְּדוּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוֻּ לַיהוָה אַפַּיִם אָרְצָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἀδείν, Ὠβὴθ υἱὸς Ἰωναθάν, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ πεντήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: et benedixit Ezras Domino Deo magno et respondit omnis populus amen amen elevans manus suas et incurvati sunt et adoraverunt Deum proni in terram
clem: Et benedixit Esdras Domino Deo magno: et respondit omnis populus: Amen, amen, elevans manus suas: et incurvati sunt, et adoraverunt Deum proni in terram.
kjv: And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the Lord with their faces to the ground.

wlc: וְיֵשׁוּעַ וּבָנִי וְשֵׁרֵבְיָה יָמִין עַקּוּב שַׁבְּתַי הוֹדִיָּה מַעֲשֵׂיָה קְלִיטָא עֲזַרְיָה יוֹזָבָד חָנָן פְּלָאיָה וְהַלְוִיִּם מְבִינִים אֶת־הָעָם לַתּוֹרָה וְהָעָם עַל־עָמְדָם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἠλά, Ἰοσειὰ υἱὸς Ἀθελεί, καὶ μετ᾿ αὐτοῦ ἑβδομήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: porro Hiesue et Baani et Serebia Iamin Accub Septhai Odia Maasia Celita Azarias Iozabed Anam Phalaia Levitae silentium faciebant in populo ad audiendam legem populus autem stabat in gradu suo
clem: Porro Josue, et Bani, et Serebia, Jamin, Accub, Septhai, Odia, Maasia, Celita, Azarias, Jozabed, Hanan, Phalaia, Levit, silentium faciebant in populo ad audiendam legem: populus autem stabat in gradu suo.
kjv: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.

wlc: וַיִּקְרְאוּ בַסֵּפֶר בְּתוֹרַת הָאֱלֹהִים מְפֹרָשׁ וְשׂוֹם שֶׂכֶל וַיָּבִינוּ בַּמִּקְרָא ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Σαφατειά, Ζαβδειὰ υἱὸς Μειχαήλ, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ὀγδοήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: et legerunt in libro legis Dei distincte et adposite ad intellegendum et intellexerunt cum legeretur
clem: Et legerunt in libro legis Dei distincte, et aperte ad intelligendum: et intellexerunt cum legeretur.
kjv: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

wlc: ס וַיֹּאמֶר נְחֶמְיָה הוּא הַתִּרְשָׁתָא וְעֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן הַסֹּפֵר וְהַלְוִיִּם הַמְּבִינִים אֶת־הָעָם לְכָל־הָעָם הַיּוֹם קָדֹשׁ־הוּא לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אַל־תִּתְאַבְּלוּ וְאַל־תִּבְכּוּ כִּי בוֹכִים כָּל־הָעָם כְּשָׁמְעָם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰωάβ, Ἀδειὰ υἱὸς Ἰεμά, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι δέκα ὀκτὼ τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: dixit autem Neemias ipse est Athersatha et Ezras sacerdos scriba et Levitae interpretantes universo populo dies sanctificatus est Domino Deo nostro nolite lugere et nolite flere flebat enim omnis populus cum audiret verba legis
clem: Dixit autem Nehemias (ipse est Athersatha) et Esdras sacerdos et scriba, et Levit interpretantes universo populo: Dies sanctificatus est Domino Deo nostro: nolite lugere, et nolite flere. Flebat enim omnis populus cum audiret verba legis.
kjv: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the Lord your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לְכוּ אִכְלוּ מַשְׁמַנִּים וּשְׁתוּ מַמְתַקִּים וְשִׁלְחוּ מָנוֹת לְאֵין נָכוֹן לוֹ כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹם לַאֲדֹנֵינוּ וְאַל־תֵּעָצֵבוּ כִּי־חֶדְוַת יְהוָה הִיא מָעֻזְּכֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Σαλειμοὺθ υἱὸς Ἰωσεφειά, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν ἐξήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: et dixit eis ite comedite pinguia et bibite mulsum et mittite partes ei qui non praeparavit sibi quia sanctus dies Domini est et nolite contristari gaudium enim Domini est fortitudo nostra
clem: Et dixit eis: Ite, comedite pinguia, et bibite mulsum, et mittite partes his qui non prparaverunt sibi, quia sanctus dies Domini est: et nolite contristari: gaudium etenim Domini est fortitudo nostra.
kjv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.

wlc: וְהַלְוִיִּם מַחְשִׁים לְכָל־הָעָם לֵאמֹר הַסּוּ כִּי הַיּוֹם קָדֹשׁ וְאַל־תֵּעָצֵבוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βαβεί, καὶ Ἀζαριὰ υἱὸς Βαβεί, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἑβδομήκοντα ὀκτὼ τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: Levitae autem silentium faciebant in omni populo dicentes tacete quia dies sanctus est et nolite dolere
clem: Levit autem silentium faciebant in omni populo, dicentes: Tacete, quia dies sanctus est, et nolite dolere.
kjv: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.

wlc: וַיֵּלְכוּ כָל־הָעָם לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וּלְשַׁלַּח מָנוֹת וְלַעֲשׂוֹת שִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה כִּי הֵבִינוּ בַּדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹדִיעוּ לָהֶם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἀστάδ, Ἰωνὰν υἱὸς Ἁκατάν, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν δέκα τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: abiit itaque omnis populus ut comederet et biberet et mitteret partes et faceret laetitiam magnam quia intellexerant verba quae docuerat eos
clem: Abiit itaque omnis populus ut comederet, et biberet, et mitteret partes, et faceret ltitiam magnam: quia intellexerant verba qu docuerat eos.
kjv: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

wlc: וּבַיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי נֶאֶסְפוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְכָל־הָעָם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם אֶל־עֶזְרָא הַסֹּפֵר וּלְהַשְׂכִּיל אֶל־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἀδανεικὰμ ἔσχατοι, καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν· Ἀλειφὰτ καὶ Εὐειὰ καὶ Σαμαιά, ἐξήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά·
vulg: et in die secundo congregati sunt principes familiarum universi populi sacerdotes et Levitae ad Ezram scribam ut interpretaretur eis verba legis
clem: Et in die secundo congregati sunt principes familiarum universi populi, sacerdotes et Levit, ad Esdram scribam, ut interpretaretur eis verba legis.
kjv: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

wlc: וַיִּמְצְאוּ כָּתוּב בַּתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר יֵשְׁבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּסֻּכּוֹת בֶּחָג בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βαγὸ Οὐθί καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ὀγδοήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά.
vulg: et invenerunt scriptum in lege praecepisse Dominum in manu Mosi ut habitent filii Israhel in tabernaculis in die sollemni mense septimo
clem: Et invenerunt scriptum in lege prcepisse Dominum in manu Moysi ut habitent filii Isral in tabernaculis in die solemni, mense septimo:
kjv: And they found written in the law which the Lord had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

wlc: וַאֲשֶׁר יַשְׁמִיעוּ וְיַעֲבִירוּ קוֹל בְּכָל־עָרֵיהֶם וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם לֵאמֹר צְאוּ הָהָר וְהָבִיאוּ עֲלֵי־זַיִת וַעֲלֵי־עֵץ שֶׁמֶן וַעֲלֵי הֲדַס וַעֲלֵי תְמָרִים וַעֲלֵי עֵץ עָבֹת לַעֲשֹׂת סֻכֹּת כַּכָּתוּב ׃ פ
lxx: Καὶ συνῆξα αὐτοὺς πρὸς τὸν ποταμὸν τὸν ἐρχόμενον πρὸς τὸν Εὐείμ, καὶ παρενεβάλομεν ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας τρεῖς· καὶ συνῆκα ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν, καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Λευεὶ οὐχ εὗρον ἐκεῖ.
vulg: et ut praedicent et divulgent vocem in universis urbibus suis et in Hierusalem dicentes egredimini in montem et adferte frondes olivae et frondes ligni pulcherrimi frondes myrti et ramos palmarum et frondes ligni nemorosi ut fiant tabernacula sicut scriptum est
clem: et ut prdicent, et divulgent vocem in universis urbibus suis, et in Jerusalem, dicentes: Egredimini in montem, et afferte frondes oliv, et frondes ligni pulcherrimi, frondes myrti, et ramos palmarum, et frondes ligni nemorosi, ut fiant tabernacula, sicut scriptum est.
kjv: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.

wlc: וַיֵּצְאוּ הָעָם וַיָּבִיאוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם סֻכּוֹת אִישׁ עַל־גַּגּוֹ וּבְחַצְרֹתֵיהֶם וּבְחַצְרוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וּבִרְחוֹב שַׁעַר הַמַּיִם וּבִרְחוֹב שַׁעַר אֶפְרָיִם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπέστειλα τῷ Ἐλεαζάρ, τῷ Ἀριήλ, τῷ Σαμαιὰ καὶ τῷ Ἀλωνὰμ καὶ τῷ Ἀρὲβ καὶ τῷ Ἐλναθὰμ καὶ τῷ Ναθὰν καὶ τῷ Ζαχαρίᾳ καὶ τῷ Μεσουὰμ ἄνδρας· καὶ τῷ Ἀρεὶβ καὶ τῷ Ἐαναθὰν συνιόντας.
vulg: et egressus est populus et adtulerunt feceruntque sibi tabernacula unusquisque in domate suo et in atriis suis et in atriis domus Dei et in platea portae Aquarum et in platea portae Ephraim
clem: Et egressus est populus, et attulerunt. Feceruntque sibi tabernacula unusquisque in domate suo: et in atriis suis, et in atriis domus Dei, et in platea port aquarum, et in platea port Ephraim.
kjv: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

wlc: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כָל־הַקָּהָל הַשָּׁבִים מִן־הַשְּׁבִי סֻכּוֹת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בַסֻּכּוֹת כִּי לֹא־עָשׂוּ מִימֵי יֵשׁוּעַ בִּן־נוּן כֵּן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וַתְּהִי שִׂמְחָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξήνεγκα αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ ἄρχοντος ἐν ἀργυρίῳ τοῦ τόπου, καὶ ἔθηκα ἐν στόματι αὐτῶν λόγους λαλῆσαι πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν τῶν Ἀθανεὶμ ἐν ἀργυρίῳ τόπου τοῦ ἐνέγκαι ἡμῖν ᾄδοντας εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν.
vulg: fecit ergo universa ecclesia eorum qui redierant de captivitate tabernacula et habitaverunt in tabernaculis non enim fecerant a diebus Iosue filii Nun taliter filii Israhel usque ad diem illum et fuit laetitia magna nimis
clem: Fecit ergo universa ecclesia eorum qui redierant de captivitate, tabernacula, et habitaverunt in tabernaculis: non enim fecerant a diebus Josue filii Nun taliter filii Isral usque ad diem illum. Et fuit ltitia magna nimis.
kjv: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

wlc: וַיִּקְרָא בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת הָאֱלֹהִים יוֹם בְּיוֹם מִן־הַיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן עַד הַיּוֹם הָאַחֲרוֹן וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־חָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת כַּמִּשְׁפָּט ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἡμῖν, ὡς χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἀγαθὴ ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς, ἀνὴρ σαχὼχ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Μοολεὶ υἱοῦ Λευεὶ υἱοῦ Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἀρχὴν ἤλθοσαν υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ὀκτὼ καὶ δέκα·
vulg: legit autem in libro legis Dei per dies singulos a die primo usque ad diem novissimum et fecerunt sollemnitatem septem diebus et in die octavo collectum iuxta ritum
clem: Legit autem in libro legis Dei per dies singulos, a die primo usque ad diem novissimum. Et fecerunt solemnitatem septem diebus, et in die octavo collectam juxta ritum.
kjv: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.

lxx: καὶ τὸν Ἁσεβειὰ καὶ τὸν Ὠσαίαν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Μεραρεί, ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν εἴκοσι·
καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Ναθεινεὶμ ὧν ἔδωκεν Δαυεὶδ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες εἰς δουλείαν τῶν Λευειτῶν, Ναθεινεὶμ διακόσιοι καὶ εἵκοσι· πάντες συνήχθησαν ἐν ὀνόμασιν.
καὶ ἐκάλεσα ἐκεῖ νηστείαν ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμὸν Θουὲ τοῦ ταπεινωθῆναι ἐνώπιον θεοῦ ἡμών, ζητῆσαι παρʼ αὐτοῦ ὁδὸν εὐθεῖαν ἡμῖν καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν καὶ πάσῃ τῇ κτήσει ἡμῶν.

ὅτι ᾐσχύνθην αἰτήσασθαι παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως δύναμιν καὶ ἱππεῖς σῶσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ ἐχθροῦ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, ὅτι εἴπαμεν τῷ βασιλεῖ λέγοντες Χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ζητοῦντας αὐτὸν εἰς ἀγαθόν, καὶ κράτος αὐτοῦ καὶ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντας ἐνκαταλείποντας αὐτόν.
καὶ ἐνηστεύσαμεν καὶ ἐζητήσαμεν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν περὶ τούτου, καὶ ἐπήκουσεν ἡμῖν.
καὶ διέστειλα ἀπὸ ἀρχόντων τῶν ἱερέων δώδεκα, τῷ Σαραιά, Ἁσαβιά, καὶ μετʼ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν δώδεκα.
καὶ ἔστησα αὐτοῖς τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὰ σκεύη ἀπαρχῆς οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν, ἃ ὕψωσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ σύμβουλοι αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ οἱ εὑρισκόμενοι.
καὶ ἔστησα ἐπὶ χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἀργυρίου τάλαντα ἑξακόσια καὶ πεντήκοντα, καὶ σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ ἑκατόν, καὶ τάλαντα χρυσίου ἑκατόν·
καὶ καφουδὴθ χρυσοῖ εἴκοσι εἰς τὴυ ὁδὸν χαμανεὶμ χίλιοι, καὶ σκεύη χαλκοῦ στίλβοντος ἀγαθοῦ διάφορα, ἐπιθυμητὰ ἐν χρυσίῳ.
καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτούς Ὑμεῖς ἅγιοι τῷ κυρίῳ, καὶ τὰ σκεύη ἅγια καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον ἑκούσια τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ πατέρων ἡμῶν·
ἀγρυπνεῖτε καὶ τηρεῖτε, ἕως στῆτε ἐνώπιον ἀρχόντων τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευειτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν πατριῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ, εἰς σκηνὰς οἴκου Κυρίου.
καὶ ἐδέξαντο οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται σταθμὸν τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ τοῦ χρυσίου καὶ τῶν σκευῶν, ἐνεγκεῖν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν.
Καὶ ἐξήραμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ Θουέ ἐν τῇ δωδεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου τοῦ ἐλθεῖν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ· καὶ χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἦν ἐφʼ ἡμῖν, καὶ ἐρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ καὶ πολεμίου ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.
καὶ ἤλθομεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ ἐκαθίσαμεν ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας τρεῖς.

καὶ ἐγενήθη τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τετάρτῃ ἐστήσαμεν τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὰ σκεύη ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ χεῖρα Μερειμὼθ υἱοῦ Οὐρεία τοῦ ἱερέως, καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ Ἐλεαζὰρ υἱὸς Φεινεές, καὶ μετʼ αὐτῶν Ἰωζαβὰδ υἱὸς Ἰησοῦ καὶ Νοαδεὶ ἀπὸ Ἐβανναιὰ οἱ Λευεῖται·
ἐν ἀριθμῷ καὶ ἐν σταθμῷ τὰ πάντα, καὶ ἐγράφη πᾶς ὁ σταθμός. ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ

διελθόντες ἐκ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας υἱοὶ τῆς παροικίας προσήνεγκαν ὁλοκαυτώσεις τῷ θεῷ Ἰσραήλ, μόσχους δώδεκα περὶ παντὸς Ἰσραήλ, κριοὺς ἐνενήκοντα ἕξ, ἀμνοὺς ἑβδομήκοντα καὶ ἑπτά, χιμάρους περὶ ἁμαρτίας δώδεκα, τὰ πάντα ὁλοκαυτωμάτααον.
καὶ ἔδωκαν τὸ νόμισμα τοῦ βασιλέως τοῖς διοικηταῖς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐπάρχοις πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ· καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν λαὸν καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ.

wlc: וּבְיוֹם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה נֶאֶסְפוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצוֹם וּבְשַׂקִּים וַאֲדָמָה עֲלֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: Καὶ ὡς ἐτελέσθη ταῦτα, ἤγγισαν πρὸς μὲ οἱ ἄρχοντες λέγοντες Οὐκ ἐχωρίσθη ὁ λαὸς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἀπὸ λαῶν τῶν γαιῶν ἐν μακρύμμασιν αὐτῶν· τῷ Χανανεί, ὁ Ἑθεί, ὁ Φερεσθεί, ὁ Ἰεβουσεί, ὁ Ἀμμωνεί, ὁ Μωάβ, ὁ Μοσερεὶ καὶ ὁ Ἀμορεί·
vulg: in die autem vicesimo quarto mensis huius convenerunt filii Israhel in ieiunio et in saccis et humus super eos
clem: In die autem vigesimo quarto mensis hujus, convenerunt filii Isral in jejunio et in saccis, et humus super eos.
kjv: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

wlc: וַיִּבָּדְלוּ זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל בְּנֵי נֵכָר וַיַּעַמְדוּ וַיִּתְוַדּוּ עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיהֶם וַעֲוֹנוֹת אֲבֹתֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐλάβοσαν ἀπὸ θυγατέρων αὐτῶν αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ παρήχθη σπέρμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐν λαοῖς τῶν γαιῶν, καὶ χεὶρ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐν τῇ ἀσυνθεσίᾳ ταύτῃ.
vulg: et separatum est semen filiorum Israhel ab omni filio alienigena et steterunt et confitebantur peccata sua et iniquitates patrum suorum
clem: Et separatum est semen filiorum Isral ab omni filio alienigena: et steterunt, et confitebantur peccata sua, et iniquitates patrum suorum.
kjv: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

wlc: וַיָּקוּמוּ עַל־עָמְדָם וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם רְבִעִית הַיּוֹם וּרְבִעִית מִתְוַדִּים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ὡς ἤκουσα τὸν λόγον τοῦτον, διέρρηξα τὰ ἱμάτιά μου καὶ ἐπαλλόμην, καὶ ἔτιλλον ἀπὸ τῶν τριχῶν τῆς κεφαλῆς μου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πώγωνός μου, καὶ ἐκαθήμην ἠρεμάζων.
vulg: et consurrexerunt ad standum et legerunt in volumine legis Domini Dei sui quater in die et quater confitebantur et adorabant Dominum Deum suum
clem: Et consurrexerunt ad standum: et legerunt in volumine legis Domini Dei sui, quater in die, et quater confitebantur, et adorabant Dominum Deum suum.
kjv: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the Lord their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the Lord their God.

wlc: וַיָּקָם עַל־מַעֲלֵה הַלְוִיִּם יֵשׁוּעַ וּבָנִי קַדְמִיאֵל שְׁבַנְיָה בֻּנִּי שֵׁרֵבְיָה בָּנִי כְנָנִי וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ συνήχθησαν πρὸς μέ πᾶς ὁ διώκων λόγον θεοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ ἀσυνθεσίᾳ τῆς ἀποικίας· καὶ ἐγὼ καθήμενος ἠρεμάζων ἕως τῆς θυσίας τῆς ἑσπερινῆς.
vulg: surrexit autem super gradum Levitarum Iosue et Bani Cedmihel Sebnia Bani Sarebias Bani Chanani et inclamaverunt voce magna Dominum Deum suum
clem: Surrexerunt autem super gradum Levitarum Josue, et Bani, et Cedmihel, Sabania, Bonni, Sarebias, Bani, et Chanani: et clamaverunt voce magna ad Dominum Deum suum.
kjv: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the Lord their God.

wlc: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַלְוִיִּם יֵשׁוּעַ וְקַדְמִיאֵל בָּנִי חֲשַׁבְנְיָה שֵׁרֵבְיָה הוֹדִיָּה שְׁבַנְיָה פְתַחְיָה קוּמוּ בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִן־הָעוֹלָם עַד־הָעוֹלָם וִיבָרְכוּ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדֶךָ וּמְרוֹמַם עַל־כָּל־בְּרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐν θυσίᾳ τῇ ἑσπερινῇ ἀνέστην ἀπὸ ταπεινώσεώς μου· καὶ ἐν τῷ διαρρῆξαί με τὰ ἱμάτιά μου καὶ ἐπαλλόμην, καὶ κλίνω ἐπὶ τὰ γόνατά μου καὶ ἐκπετάζω χεῖράς μου πρὸς τὸν θεόν,
vulg: et dixerunt Levitae Iosue et Cedmihel Bonni Asebia Serebia Odoia Sebna Fataia surgite benedicite Domino Deo vestro ab aeterno usque in aeternum et benedicant nomini gloriae tuae excelso in omni benedictione et laude
clem: Et dixerunt Levit Josue, et Cedmihel, Bonni, Hasebnia, Serebia, Odaia, Sebnia, Phathathia: Surgite, benedicite Domino Deo vestro ab terno usque in ternum: et benedicant nomini glori tu excelso in omni benedictione et laude.
kjv: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the Lord your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

wlc: אַתָּה־הוּא יְהוָה לְבַדֶּךָ אַתְּ עָשִׂיתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְכָל־צְבָאָם הָאָרֶץ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ הַיַּמִּים וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם וְאַתָּה מְחַיֶּה אֶת־כֻּלָּם וּצְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם לְךָ מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπα, Ἠσχύνθην καὶ ἐνετράπην τοῦ ὑψῶσαι τὸ πρόσωπόν μου πρὸς σέ, ὅτι αἱ ἀνομίαι ἡμῶν ἐπληθύνθησαν ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς ἡμῶν, καὶ αἱ πλημμέλειαι ἡμῶν ἐμεγαλύνθησαν ἕως εἰς οὐρανόν.
vulg: tu ipse Domine solus tu fecisti caelum caelum caelorum et omnem exercitum eorum terram et universa quae in ea sunt maria et omnia quae in eis sunt et tu vivificas omnia haec et exercitus caeli te adorat
clem: Tu ipse, Domine, solus, tu fecisti clum, et clum clorum, et omnem exercitum eorum: terram, et universa qu in ea sunt: maria, et omnia qu in eis sunt: et tu vivificas omnia hc, et exercitus cli te adorat.
kjv: Thou, even thou, art Lord alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

wlc: אַתָּה־הוּא יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתָּ בְּאַבְרָם וְהוֹצֵאתוֹ מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים וְשַׂמְתָּ שְּׁמוֹ אַבְרָהָם ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ ἡμερῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἐσμεν ἐν πλημμελείᾳ μεγάλῃ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης· καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις ἡμῶν παρεδόθημεν ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ἡμῶν ἐν χειρὶ βασιλέων τῶν ἐθνῶν, ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν αἰχμαλωσία, ἐν διαρπαγῇ καὶ ἐν αἰσχύνῃ προσώπου ἡμῶν, ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη.
vulg: tu ipse Domine Deus qui elegisti Abram et eduxisti eum de igne Chaldeorum et posuisti nomen eius Abraham
clem: Tu ipse, Domine Deus, qui elegisti Abram, et eduxisti eum de igne Chaldorum, et posuisti nomen ejus Abraham:
kjv: Thou art the Lord the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

wlc: וּמָצָאתָ אֶת־לְבָבוֹ נֶאֱמָן לְפָנֶיךָ וְכָרוֹת עִמּוֹ הַבְּרִית לָתֵת אֶת־אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי הָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁי לָתֵת לְזַרְעוֹ וַתָּקֶם אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ כִּי צַדִּיק אָתָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν ἐπεσκευάσατο ἡμῖν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τοῦ καταλιπεῖν ἡμῖν εἰς σωτηρίαν καὶ δοῦναι ἡμῖν στήρισμα ἐν τόπῳ ἁγιάσματος αὐτοῦ, τοῦ φωτίσαι ὀφθαλμοὺς ἡμῶν καὶ δοῦναι ζωοποίησιν μικρὰν ἐν τῇ δουλείᾳ ἡμῶν.
vulg: et invenisti cor eius fidele coram te et percussisti cum eo foedus ut dares ei terram Chananei Chetthei Amorrei et Ferezei et Iebusei et Gergesei ut dares semini eius et implesti verba tua quoniam iustus es
clem: et invenisti cor ejus fidele coram te, et percussisti cum eo fdus ut dares ei terram Chanani, Hethi, et Amorrhi, et Pherezi, et Jebusi, et Gergesi, ut dares semini ejus: et implesti verba tua, quoniam justus es.
kjv: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:

wlc: וַתֵּרֶא אֶת־עֳנִי אֲבֹתֵינוּ בְּמִצְרָיִם וְאֶת־זַעֲקָתָם שָׁמַעְתָּ עַל־יַם־סוּף ׃
lxx: ὅτι δοῦλοί ἐσμεν, καὶ ἐν τῇ δουλείᾳ ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐνκατέλειπεν ἡμᾶς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, καὶ ἔκλινεν ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ἔλεος ἐνώπιον βασιλέων Περσῶν, δοῦναι ἡμῖν ζωοποίησιν, τοῦ ὑψῶσαι αὐτοὺς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ ἀναστῆσαι τὰ ἔρημα αὐτῆς, καὶ τοῦ δοῦναι ἡμῖν φραγμὸν ἐν Ἰούδᾳ καὶ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: et vidisti adflictionem patrum nostrorum in Aegypto clamoremque eorum audisti super mare Rubrum
clem: Et vidisti afflictionem patrum nostrorum in gypto, clamoremque eorum audisti super mare Rubrum.
kjv: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

wlc: וַתִּתֵּן אֹתֹת וּמֹפְתִים בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָיו וּבְכָל־עַם אַרְצוֹ כִּי יָדַעְתָּ כִּי הֵזִידוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַתַּעַשׂ־לְךָ שֵׁם כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה ׃
lxx: τί εἴπωμεν, ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, μετὰ τοῦτο; ὅτι ἐνκατελίπομεν ἐντολάς σου
vulg: et dedisti signa et portenta in Pharao et in universis servis eius et in omni populo terrae illius cognovisti enim quia superbe egerant contra eos et fecisti tibi nomen sicut et in hac die
clem: Et dedisti signa atque portenta in Pharaone, et in universis servis ejus, et in omni populo terr illius: cognovisti enim quia superbe egerant contra eos: et fecisti tibi nomen, sicut et in hac die.
kjv: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.

wlc: וְהַיָּם בָּקַעְתָּ לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְתוֹךְ־הַיָּם בַּיַּבָּשָׁה וְאֶת־רֹדְפֵיהֶם הִשְׁלַכְתָּ בִמְצוֹלֹת כְּמוֹ־אֶבֶן בְּמַיִם עַזִּים ׃
lxx: ἃς ἔδωκας ἡμῖν ἐν χειρὶ δούλων σου τῶν προφητῶν Ἡ γῆ εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύεσθε κληρονομῆσαι αὐτὴν γῆ μετακινουμένη ἐστὶν ἐν μετακινήσει λαῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν, ἐν μακρύμμασιν αὐτῶν, ὧν ἔπλησαν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ στόματος ἐπὶ στόμα ἐν ἀκαθαρσίαις αὐτῶν.
vulg: et mare divisisti ante eos et transierunt per medium maris in sicca persecutores autem eorum proiecisti in profundum quasi lapidem in aquas validas
clem: Et mare divisisti ante eos, et transierunt per medium maris in sicco: persecutores autem eorum projecisti in profundum, quasi lapidem in aquas validas.
kjv: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

wlc: וּבְעַמּוּד עָנָן הִנְחִיתָם יוֹמָם וּבְעַמּוּד אֵשׁ לַיְלָה לְהָאִיר לָהֶם אֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ־בָהּ ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν μὴ δῶτε τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀπὸ θυγατέρων αὐτῶν μὴ λάβητε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν, καὶ οὐκ ἐκζητήσετε εἰρήνην αὐτῶν καὶ ἀγαθὸν αὐτῶν ἕως αἰῶνος, ὅπως ἐνισχύσητε καὶ φάγητε τὰ ἀγαθὰ τῆς γῆς καὶ κληροδοτήσητε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν ἕως αἰῶνος.
vulg: et in columna nubis ductor eorum fuisti per diem et in columna ignis per noctem ut appareret eis via per quam ingrediebantur
clem: Et in columna nubis ductor eorum fuisti per diem, et in columna ignis per noctem, ut appareret eis via per quam ingrediebantur.
kjv: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

wlc: וְעַל הַר־סִינַי יָרַדְתָּ וְדַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם מִשָּׁמָיִם וַתִּתֵּן לָהֶם מִשְׁפָּטִים יְשָׁרִים וְתוֹרוֹת אֱמֶת חֻקִּים וּמִצְוֹת טוֹבִים ׃
lxx: καὶ μετὰ πᾶν τὸ ἐρχόμενον ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς ἐν ποιήμασιν ὑμῶν τοῖς πονηροῖς καὶ ἐν πλημμελείᾳ ὑμῶν τῇ μεγάλῃ· ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, ὅτι ἐκούφισας ἡμῶν τὰς ἀνομίας καὶ ἔδωκας ἡμῖν σωτηρίαν·
vulg: ad montem quoque Sinai descendisti et locutus es cum eis de caelo et dedisti eis iudicia recta et legem veritatis caerimonias et praecepta bona
clem: Ad montem quoque Sinai descendisti, et locutus es cum eis de clo, et dedisti eis judicia recta, et legem veritatis, cremonias, et prcepta bona:
kjv: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

wlc: וְאֶת־שַׁבַּת קָדְשְׁךָ הוֹדַעַתָ לָהֶם וּמִצְווֹת וְחֻקִּים וְתוֹרָה צִוִּיתָ לָהֶם בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐπεστρέψαμεν διασκεδάσαι ἐντολάς σου καὶ γαμβρεῦσαι τοῖς λαοῖς· μὴ παροξυνθῇς ἐν ἡμῖν ἕως συντελείας τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἐνκατάλειμμα καὶ διασωζόμενον.
vulg: et sabbatum sanctificatum tuum ostendisti eis et mandata et caerimonias et legem praecepisti eis in manu Mosi servi tui
clem: et sabbatum sanctificatum tuum ostendisti eis: et mandata, et cremonias, et legem prcepisti eis in manu Moysi servi tui.
kjv: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

wlc: וְלֶחֶם מִשָּׁמַיִם נָתַתָּה לָהֶם לִרְעָבָם וּמַיִם מִסֶּלַע הוֹצֵאתָ לָהֶם לִצְמָאָם וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָבוֹא לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָשָׂאתָ אֶת־יָדְךָ לָתֵת לָהֶם ׃
lxx: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ, δίκαιος σύ, ὅτι κατελείφθημεν διασωζόμενοι ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη· ἐναντίον σου ἐν πλημμελείαις ἡμῶν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν στῆναι ἐνώπιόν σου ἐπὶ τούτῳ.
vulg: panem quoque de caelo dedisti eis in fame eorum et aquam de petra eduxisti eis sitientibus et dixisti eis ut ingrederentur et possiderent terram super quam levasti manum tuam ut traderes eis
clem: Panem quoque de clo dedisti eis in fame eorum, et aquam de petra eduxisti eis sitientibus, et dixisti eis ut ingrederentur et possiderent terram, super quam levasti manum tuam ut traderes eis.
kjv: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

wlc: וְהֵם וַאֲבֹתֵינוּ הֵזִידוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־עָרְפָּם וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֶל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ ׃
vulg: ipsi vero et patres nostri superbe egerunt et induraverunt cervices suas et non audierunt mandata tua
clem: Ipsi vero et patres nostri superbe egerunt, et induraverunt cervices suas, et non audierunt mandata tua.
kjv: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

wlc: וַיְמָאֲנוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ וְלֹא־זָכְרוּ נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּהֶם וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־עָרְפָּם וַיִּתְּנוּ־רֹאשׁ לָשׁוּב לְעַבְדֻתָם בְּמִרְיָם וְאַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֶרֶךְ־אַפַּיִם וְרַב־וְחֶסֶד וְלֹא עֲזַבְתָּם ׃
vulg: et noluerunt audire et non sunt recordati mirabilium tuorum quae feceras eis et induraverunt cervices suas et dederunt caput ut converterentur ad servitutem suam quasi per contentionem tu autem Deus propitius clemens et misericors longanimis et multae miserationis non dereliquisti eos
clem: Et noluerunt audire, et non sunt recordati mirabilium tuorum qu feceras eis. Et induraverunt cervices suas, et dederunt caput ut converterentur ad servitutem suam, quasi per contentionem. Tu autem, Deus propitius, clemens, et misericors, longanimis, et mult miserationis, non dereliquisti eos,
kjv: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

wlc: אַף כִּי־עָשׂוּ לָהֶם עֵגֶל מַסֵּכָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֶה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֶלְךָ מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ נֶאָצוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת ׃
vulg: et quidem cum fecissent sibi vitulum conflatilem et dixissent iste est Deus tuus qui eduxit te de Aegypto feceruntque blasphemias magnas
clem: et quidem cum fecissent sibi vitulum conflatilem, et dixissent: Iste est deus tuus, qui eduxit te de gypto: feceruntque blasphemias magnas:
kjv: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

wlc: וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים לֹא עֲזַבְתָּם בַּמִּדְבָּר אֶת־עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן לֹא־סָר מֵעֲלֵיהֶם בְּיוֹמָם לְהַנְחֹתָם בְּהַדֶּרֶךְ וְאֶת־עַמּוּד הָאֵשׁ בְּלַיְלָה לְהָאִיר לָהֶם וְאֶת־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יֵלְכוּ־בָהּ ׃
vulg: tu autem in misericordiis tuis multis non dimisisti eos in deserto columna nubis non recessit ab eis per diem ut duceret eos in via et columna ignis in nocte ut ostenderet eis iter per quod ingrederentur
clem: tu autem in misericordiis tuis multis non dimisisti eos in deserto: columna nubis non recessit ab eis per diem ut duceret eos in viam, et columna ignis per noctem ut ostenderet eis iter per quod ingrederentur.
kjv: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

wlc: וְרוּחֲךָ הַטּוֹבָה נָתַתָּ לְהַשְׂכִּילָם וּמַנְךָ לֹא־מָנַעְתָּ מִפִּיהֶם וּמַיִם נָתַתָּה לָהֶם לִצְמָאָם ׃
vulg: et spiritum tuum bonum dedisti qui doceret eos et manna tuum non prohibuisti ab ore eorum et aquam dedisti eis in siti
clem: Et spiritum tuum bonum dedisti, qui doceret eos: et manna tuum non prohibuisti ab ore eorum, et aquam dedisti eis in siti.
kjv: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

wlc: וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה כִּלְכַּלְתָּם בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹא חָסֵרוּ שַׂלְמֹתֵיהֶם לֹא בָלוּ וְרַגְלֵיהֶם לֹא בָצֵקוּ ׃
vulg: quadraginta annis pavisti eos in deserto nihilque eis defuit vestimenta eorum non inveteraverunt et pedes eorum non sunt adtriti
clem: Quadraginta annis pavisti eos in deserto, nihilque eis defuit: vestimenta eorum non inveteraverunt, et pedes eorum non sunt attriti.
kjv: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

wlc: וַתִּתֵּן לָהֶם מַמְלָכוֹת וַעֲמָמִים וַתַּחְלְקֵם לְפֵאָה וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אֶרֶץ סִיחוֹן וְאֶת־אֶרֶץ מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת־אֶרֶץ עוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן ׃
vulg: et dedisti eis regna et populos et partitus es eis sortes et possederunt terram Seon et terram regis Esebon et terram Og regis Basan
clem: Et dedisti eis regna, et populos, et partitus es eis sortes: et possederunt terram Sehon, et terram regis Hesebon, et terram Og regis Basan.
kjv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

wlc: וּבְנֵיהֶם הִרְבִּיתָ כְּכֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וַתְּבִיאֵם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אָמַרְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵיהֶם לָבוֹא לָרָשֶׁת ׃
vulg: et filios eorum multiplicasti sicut stellas caeli et adduxisti eos ad terram de qua dixeras patribus eorum ut ingrederentur et possiderent
clem: Et multiplicasti filios eorum sicut stellas cli, et adduxisti eos ad terram de qua dixeras patribus eorum ut ingrederentur et possiderent.
kjv: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.

wlc: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַבָּנִים וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַתַּכְנַע לִפְנֵיהֶם אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִים וַתִּתְּנֵם בְּיָדָם וְאֶת־מַלְכֵיהֶם וְאֶת־עַמְמֵי הָאָרֶץ לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם כִּרְצוֹנָם ׃
vulg: et venerunt filii et possederunt terram et humiliasti coram eis habitatores terrae Chananeos et dedisti eos in manu eorum et reges eorum et populos terrae ut facerent eis sicut placebat illis
clem: Et venerunt filii, et possederunt terram, et humiliasti coram eis habitatores terr Chananos, et dedisti eos in manu eorum, et reges eorum, et populos terr, ut facerent eis sicut placebant illis.
kjv: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

wlc: וַיִּלְכְּדוּ עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת וַאֲדָמָה שְׁמֵנָה וַיִּירְשׁוּ בָּתִּים מְלֵאִים־כָּל־טוּב בֹּרוֹת חֲצוּבִים כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים וְעֵץ מַאֲכָל לָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׂבְּעוּ וַיַּשְׁמִינוּ וַיִּתְעַדְּנוּ בְּטוּבְךָ הַגָּדוֹל ׃
vulg: ceperunt itaque urbes munitas et humum pinguem et possederunt domos plenas cunctis bonis cisternas ab aliis fabricatas vineas et oliveta et ligna pomifera multa et comederunt et saturati sunt et inpinguati sunt et abundavere deliciis in bonitate tua magna
clem: Ceperunt itaque urbes munitas et humum pinguem, et possederunt domos plenas cunctis bonis: cisternas ab aliis fabricatas, vineas, et oliveta, et ligna pomifera multa: et comederunt, et saturati sunt, et impinguati sunt, et abundaverunt deliciis in bonitate tua magna.
kjv: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

wlc: וַיַּמְרוּ וַיִּמְרְדוּ בָּךְ וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֶת־תּוֹרָתְךָ אַחֲרֵי גַוָּם וְאֶת־נְבִיאֶיךָ הָרָגוּ אֲשֶׁר־הֵעִידוּ בָם לַהֲשִׁיבָם אֵלֶיךָ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ נֶאָצוֹת גְּדוֹלֹת ׃
vulg: provocaverunt autem te ad iracundiam et recesserunt a te et proiecerunt legem tuam post terga sua et prophetas tuos occiderunt qui contestabantur eos ut reverterentur ad te feceruntque blasphemias grandes
clem: Provocaverunt autem te ad iracundiam, et recesserunt a te, et projecerunt legem tuam post terga sua: et prophetas tuos occiderunt, qui contestabantur eos ut reverterentur ad te: feceruntque blasphemias grandes.
kjv: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

wlc: וַתִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד צָרֵיהֶם וַיָּצֵרוּ לָהֶם וּבְעֵת צָרָתָם יִצְעֲקוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְאַתָּה מִשָּׁמַיִם תִּשְׁמָע וּכְרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים תִּתֵּן לָהֶם מוֹשִׁיעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעוּם מִיַּד צָרֵיהֶם ׃
vulg: et dedisti eos in manu hostium suorum et adflixerunt eos et in tempore tribulationis suae clamaverunt ad te et tu de caelo audisti et secundum miserationes tuas multas dedisti eis salvatores qui salvaverunt eos de manu hostium suorum
clem: Et dedisti eos in manu hostium suorum, et afflixerunt eos. Et in tempore tribulationis su clamaverunt ad te, et tu de clo audisti, et secundum miserationes tuas multas dedisti eis salvatores, qui salvarent eos de manu hostium suorum.
kjv: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

wlc: וּכְנוֹחַ לָהֶם יָשׁוּבוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת רַע לְפָנֶיךָ וַתַּעַזְבֵם בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּרְדּוּ בָהֶם וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיִּזְעָקוּךָ וְאַתָּה מִשָּׁמַיִם תִּשְׁמַע וְתַצִּילֵם כְּרַחֲמֶיךָ רַבּוֹת עִתִּים ׃
vulg: cumque requievissent reversi sunt ut facerent malum in conspectu tuo et dereliquisti eos in manu inimicorum suorum et possederunt eos conversique sunt et clamaverunt ad te tu autem de caelo audisti et liberasti eos in misericordiis tuis multis temporibus
