clem: Cumque requievissent, reversi sunt ut facerent malum in conspectu tuo, et dereliquisti eos in manu inimicorum suorum, et possederunt eos. Conversique sunt, et clamaverunt ad te: tu autem de clo exaudisti, et liberasti eos in misericordiis tuis, multis temporibus.
kjv: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the land of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

wlc: וַתָּעַד בָּהֶם לַהֲשִׁיבָם אֶל־תּוֹרָתֶךָ וְהֵמָּה הֵזִידוּ וְלֹא־שָׁמְעוּ לְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וּבְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חָטְאוּ־בָם אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה אָדָם וְחָיָה בָהֶם וַיִּתְּנוּ כָתֵף סוֹרֶרֶת וְעָרְפָּם הִקְשׁוּ וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ ׃
vulg: et contestatus es eos ut reverterentur ad legem tuam ipsi vero superbe egerunt et non audierunt mandata tua et in iudiciis tuis peccaverunt quae faciet homo et vivet in eis et dederunt umerum recedentem et cervicem suam induraverunt nec audierunt
clem: Et contestatus es eos ut reverterentur ad legem tuam. Ipsi vero superbe egerunt, et non audierunt mandata tua, et in judiciis tuis peccaverunt, qu faciet homo, et vivet in eis: et dederunt humerum recedentem, et cervicem suam induraverunt, nec audierunt.
kjv: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

wlc: וַתִּמְשֹׁךְ עֲלֵיהֶם שָׁנִים רַבּוֹת וַתָּעַד בָּם בְּרוּחֲךָ בְּיַד־נְבִיאֶיךָ וְלֹא הֶאֱזִינוּ וַתִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד עַמֵּי הָאֲרָצֹת ׃
vulg: et protraxisti super eos annos multos et contestatus es eos in spiritu tuo per manum prophetarum tuorum et non audierunt et tradidisti eos in manu populorum terrarum
clem: Et protraxisti super eos annos multos, et contestatus es eos in spiritu tuo per manum prophetarum tuorum: et non audierunt, et tradidisti eos in manu populorum terrarum.
kjv: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.

wlc: וּבְרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים לֹא־עֲשִׂיתָם כָּלָה וְלֹא עֲזַבְתָּם כִּי אֵל־חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה ׃
vulg: in misericordiis autem tuis plurimis non fecisti eos in consumptione nec dereliquisti eos quoniam Deus miserationum et clemens tu es
clem: In misericordiis autem tuis plurimis non fecisti eos in consumptionem, nec dereliquisti eos: quoniam Deus miserationum et clemens es tu.
kjv: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.

wlc: וְעַתָּה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא שׁוֹמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד אַל־יִמְעַט לְפָנֶיךָ אֵת כָּל־הַתְּלָאָה אֲשֶׁר־מְצָאַתְנוּ לִמְלָכֵינוּ לְשָׂרֵינוּ וּלְכֹהֲנֵינוּ וְלִנְבִיאֵנוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵינוּ וּלְכָל־עַמֶּךָ מִימֵי מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה ׃
vulg: nunc itaque Deus noster Deus magne fortis et terribilis custodiens pactum et misericordiam ne avertas a facie tua omnem laborem qui invenit nos reges nostros principes nostros et sacerdotes nostros prophetas nostros et patres nostros et omnem populum tuum a diebus regis Assur usque in diem hanc
clem: Nunc itaque Deus noster magne, fortis et terribilis, custodiens pactum et misericordiam, ne avertas a facie tua omnem laborem, qui invenit nos, reges nostros, et principes nostros, et sacerdotes nostros, et prophetas nostros, et patres nostros, et omnem populum tuum a diebus regis Assur usque in diem hanc.
kjv: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

wlc: וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ כִּי־אֱמֶת עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲנַחְנוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ ׃
vulg: et tu iustus in omnibus quae venerunt super nos quia veritatem fecisti nos autem impie egimus
clem: Et tu justus es in omnibus qu venerunt super nos: quia veritatem fecisti, nos autem impie egimus.
kjv: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

wlc: וְאֶת־מְלָכֵינוּ שָׂרֵינוּ כֹּהֲנֵינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵינוּ לֹא עָשׂוּ תּוֹרָתֶךָ וְלֹא הִקְשִׁיבוּ אֶל־מִצְוֹתֶיךָ וּלְעֵדְוֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הַעִידֹתָ בָּהֶם ׃
vulg: reges nostri principes nostri sacerdotes nostri et patres nostri non fecerunt legem tuam et non adtenderunt mandata tua et testimonia tua quae testificatus es in eis
clem: Reges nostri, principes nostri, sacerdotes nostri et patres nostri non fecerunt legem tuam, et non attenderunt mandata tua, et testimonia tua qu testificatus es in eis.
kjv: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

wlc: וְהֵם בְּמַלְכוּתָם וּבְטוּבְךָ הָרָב אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּ לָהֶם וּבְאֶרֶץ הָרְחָבָה וְהַשְּׁמֵנָה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּ לִפְנֵיהֶם לֹא עֲבָדוּךָ וְלֹא־שָׁבוּ מִמַּעַלְלֵיהֶם הָרָעִים ׃
vulg: et ipsi in regnis suis bonis et in bonitate tua multa quam dederas eis et in terra latissima et pingui quam tradideras in conspectu eorum non servierunt tibi nec reversi sunt ab studiis suis pessimis
clem: Et ipsi in regnis suis, et in bonitate tua multa quam dederas eis, et in terra latissima et pingui quam tradideras in conspectu eorum, non servierunt tibi, nec reversi sunt a studiis suis pessimis.
kjv: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

wlc: הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ הַיּוֹם עֲבָדִים וְהָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ לֶאֱכֹל אֶת־פִּרְיָהּ וְאֶת־טוּבָהּ הִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ עֲבָדִים עָלֶיהָ ׃
vulg: ecce nos ipsi hodie servi sumus et terram quam dedisti patribus nostris ut comederent panem eius et quae bona sunt eius et nos ipsi servi sumus in ea
clem: Ecce nos ipsi hodie servi sumus: et terra quam dedisti patribus nostris ut comederent panem ejus, et qu bona sunt ejus, et nos ipsi servi sumus in ea.
kjv: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:

wlc: וּתְבוּאָתָהּ מַרְבָּה לַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתָּה עָלֵינוּ בְּחַטֹּאותֵינוּ וְעַל גְּוִיֹּתֵינוּ מֹשְׁלִים וּבִבְהֶמְתֵּנוּ כִּרְצוֹנָם וּבְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָחְנוּ ׃ פ
vulg: et fruges eius multiplicantur regibus quos posuisti super nos propter peccata nostra et in corporibus nostris dominantur et in iumentis nostris secundum voluntatem suam et in tribulatione magna sumus
clem: Et fruges ejus multiplicantur regibus quos posuisti super nos propter peccata nostra: et corporibus nostris dominantur, et jumentis nostris secundum voluntatem suam: et in tribulatione magna sumus.
kjv: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

vulg: super omnibus ergo his nos ipsi percutimus foedus et scribimus et signant principes nostri Levitae nostri et sacerdotes nostri
clem: Super omnibus ergo his nos ipsi percutimus fdus, et scribimus: et signant principes nostri, Levit nostri, et sacerdotes nostri.
kjv: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.

wlc: וּבְכָל־זֹאת אֲנַחְנוּ כֹּרְתִים אֲמָנָה וְכֹתְבִים וְעַל הֶחָתוּם שָׂרֵינוּ לְוִיֵּנוּ כֹּהֲנֵינוּ ׃
lxx: Καὶ ὡς ἐπροσηύξατο Ἔσρας, καὶ ὡς προσηγόρευσεν κλαίων προσευχόμενος ἐνώπιον οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ, συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀπὸ Ἰσραὴλ ἐκκλησία πολλὴ σφόδρα, ἄνδρες καὶ γυναῖκες καὶ νεανίσκοι· ὅτι ἔκλαυσεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ὕψωσεν κλαίων.
vulg: signatores autem fuerunt Neemias Athersatha filius Achelai et Sedecias
clem: Signatores autem fuerunt Nehemias, Athersatha filius Hachelai, et Sedecias,
kjv: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

wlc: וְעַל הַחֲתוּמִים נְחֶמְיָה הַתִּרְשָׁתָא בֶּן־חֲכַלְיָה וְצִדְקִיָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Σεχενίας υἱὸς Ἰεὴλ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἠλὰμ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ἔσρᾳ Ἡεὶς ἠσυνθετήσαμεν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκαθίσαμεν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας ἀπὸ λαῶν τῆς γῆς· καὶ νῦν ἐστὶν ὑπομονὴ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ τούτῳ.
vulg: Saraias Azarias Hieremias
clem: Saraias, Azarias, Jeremias,
kjv: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

wlc: שְׂרָיָה עֲזַרְיָה יִרְמְיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν διαθώμεθα διαθήκην τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἐκβαλεῖν πάσας τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ γενόμενα ἐξ αὐτῶν, ὡς ἂν βούλῃ· ἀνάστηθι καὶ φοβέρισον αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐντολαῖς θεοῦ ἡμῶν, καὶ ὡς ὁ νόμος γενηθήτω.
vulg: Phessur Amaria Melchia
clem: Pheshur, Amarias, Melchias,
kjv: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

wlc: פַּשְׁחוּר אֲמַרְיָה מַלְכִּיָּה ׃
lxx: ἀνάστα, ὅτι ἐπὶ σὲ τὸ ῥῆμα, καὶ ἡμεῖς μετὰ σοῦ· κραταιοῦ καὶ ποίησον.
vulg: Attus Sebenia Melluc
clem: Hattus, Sebenia, Melluch,
kjv: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

wlc: חַטּוּשׁ שְׁבַנְיָה מַלּוּךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἔσρας καὶ ὥρκισεν τοὺς ἄρχοντας, τοὺς Λευείτας καὶ πάντα Ἰσραήλ, τοῦ ποιῆσαι κατὰ τὸ ἡῆμα τοῦτο· καὶ ὤμοσαν.
vulg: Arem Mermuth Obdias
clem: Harem, Merimuth, Obdias,
kjv: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

wlc: חָרִם מְרֵמוֹת עֹבַדְיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἔσρας ἀπὸ προσώπου οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς γαζοφυλάκιον Ἰωανὰν υἱοῦ Ἐλεισούβ, καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖ· ἄρτον οὐκ ἔφαγεν καὶ ὕδωρ οὐκ ἔπιεν, ὅτι ἐπένθει ἐπὶ ἀσυνθεσίᾳ τῆς ἀποικίας.
vulg: Danihel Genton Baruch
clem: Daniel, Genthon, Baruch,
kjv: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

wlc: דָּנִיֵּאל גִּנְּתוֹן בָּרוּךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ παρήνεγκαν φωνὴν Ἰούδᾳ καὶ ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ
vulg: Mosollam Abia Miamin
clem: Mosollam, Abia, Miamin,
kjv: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

wlc: מְשֻׁלָּם אֲבִיָּה מִיָּמִן ׃
lxx: Πᾶς ὃς ἂν μὴ ἔλθῃ εἰς τρεῖς ἡμέρας ὡς ἡ βουλὴ τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, ἀναθεματισθήσεται πᾶσα ἡ ὕπαρξις αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὸς διασταλήσεται ἀπὸ ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἀποι κίας.
vulg: Mazia Belga Semaia hii sacerdotes
clem: Maazia, Belgai, Semeia: hi sacerdotes.
kjv: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.

wlc: מַעַזְיָה בִלְגַּי שְׁמַעְיָה אֵלֶּה הַכֹּהֲנִים ׃ ס
lxx: Καὶ συνήχθησαν πάντες ἄνδρες Ἰούδα καὶ Βενιαμεὶν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς τὰς τρεῖς ἡμέρας, οὗτος μὴν ὁ ἔνατος· ἐν εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνὸς ἐκάθισεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐν πλατείᾳ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀπὸ θορύβου αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ χειμῶνος.
vulg: porro Levitae Iosue filius Azaniae Bennui de filiis Enadad Cedmihel
clem: Porro Levit, Josue filius Azani, Bennui de filiis Henadad, Cedmihel,
kjv: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

wlc: וְהַלְוִיִּם וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־אֲזַנְיָה בִּנּוּי מִבְּנֵי חֵנָדָד קַדְמִיאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἔσρας ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ὑμεῖς ἠσυνθετήκατε καὶ ἐκαθίσατε γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας, τοῦ προσθεῖναι ἐπὶ πλημμέλειαν Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: et fratres eorum Sechenia Odevia Celita Phalaia Anan
clem: et fratres eorum, Sebenia, Odaia, Celita, Phalaia, Hanan,
kjv: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

wlc: וַאֲחֵיהֶם שְׁבַנְיָה הוֹדִיָּה קְלִיטָא פְּלָאיָה חָנָן ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν δότε αἴνεσιν τῷ θεῷ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, καὶ ποιήσατε τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, καὶ διαστάλητε ἀπὸ λαῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γυναικῶν τῶν ἀλλοτρίων.
vulg: Micha Roob Asebia
clem: Micha, Rohob, Hasebia,
kjv: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

wlc: מִיכָא רְחוֹב חֲשַׁבְיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν πᾶσα ἐκκλησία καὶ εἶπαν Μέγα τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ποιῆσαι.
vulg: Zacchur Serebia Sabania
clem: Zachur, Serebia, Sabania,
kjv: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

wlc: זַכּוּר שֵׁרֵבְיָה שְׁבַנְיָה ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ ὁ λαὸς πολύς, καὶ ὁ τόπος χειμερινός, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν δύναμις στῆναι ἔξω· καὶ τὸ ἔργον οὐκ εἰς ἡμέραν μίαν καὶ οὐκ εἰς δύο, ὅτι ἐπληθύναμεν τοῦ ἀδικῆσαι ἐν τῷ ῥήματι τούτῳ.
vulg: Odia Bani Baninu
clem: Odaia, Bani, Baninu.
kjv: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

wlc: הוֹדִיָּה בָנִי בְּנִינוּ ׃ ס
lxx: στήτωσαν δὴ ἄρχοντες ἡμῶν· καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν πόλεσιν ἡμῶν ὃς ἐκάθισεν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας, ἐλθέτωσαν εἰς καιροὺς ἀπὸ συναγαγῶν, καὶ μετʼ αὐτῶν πρεσβύτεροι πόλεως καὶ πόλεως καὶ κριταί, τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι ὀργὴν θυμοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐξ ἡμῶν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου.
vulg: capita populi Pheros Phaethmoab Helam Zethu Bani
clem: Capita populi, Pharos, Phahathmoab, lam, Zethu, Bani,
kjv: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

wlc: רָאשֵׁי הָעָם פַּרְעֹשׁ פַּחַת מוֹאָב עֵילָם זַתּוּא בָּנִי ׃
lxx: πλὴν Ἰωναθὰν υἱὸς Ἁσὴλ καὶ Λαζειὰ υἱὸς Ἑλκειὰ μετʼ ἐμοῦ περὶ τούτου, καὶ Μεσουλὰμ καὶ Σαβαθαὶ ὁ Λευείτης βοηθῶν αὐτοῖς.
vulg: Bonni Azgad Bebai
clem: Bonni, Azgad, Bebai,
kjv: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

wlc: בֻּנִּי עַזְגָּד בֵּבָי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως υἱοὶ τῆς ἀποικίας· καὶ διεστάλησαν Ἐσρας ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἄνδρες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τῷ οἴκῳ καὶ πάντες ἐν ὀνόμασιν, ὅτι ἐπέστρεψαν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ δεκάτου ἐκζητῆσαι τὸ ῥῆμα.
vulg: Adonia Beggoai Adin
clem: Adonia, Begoai, Adin,
kjv: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

wlc: אֲדֹנִיָּה בִגְוַי עָדִין ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐτέλεσαν ἐν πᾶσιν ἀνδράσιν οἳ ἐκάθισαν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας ἕως ἡμέρας μιᾶς τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου.
vulg: Ater Ezechia Azur
clem: Ater, Hezecia, Azur,
kjv: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,

wlc: אָטֵר חִזְקִיָּה עַזּוּר ׃
lxx: Καὶ εὑρέθη ἀπὸ υἱῶν τῶν ἱερέων οἳ ἐκάθισαν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας· ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰησοῦ υἱοῦ Ἰωσεδὲκ, καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Μεεσσὴλ καὶ Ἐλιέζερ καὶ Ἰαρεὶμ καὶ Γαδαλειά·
vulg: Odevia Asum Besai
clem: Odaia, Hasum, Besai,
kjv: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

wlc: הוֹדִיָּה חָשֻׁם בֵּצָי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔδωκαν χεῖρα αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐξενέγκαι γυναῖκας αὐτῶν καὶ πλημμελείας κριὸν ἐκ προβάτων περὶ πλημμελήσεως αὐτῶν·
vulg: Ares Anathoth Nebai
clem: Hareph, Anathoth, Nebai,
kjv: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

wlc: חָרִיף עֲנָתוֹת נוֹבָי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἐμμήρ, Ἀνανεὶ καὶ Ζαβδειά·
vulg: Mecphia Mosollam Azir
clem: Megphias, Mosollam, Hazir,
kjv: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

wlc: מַגְפִּיעָשׁ מְשֻׁלָּם חֵזִיר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἡράμ, Μασαὴλ καὶ Ἐλειὰ καὶ Σαμαιὰ καὶ Ἰεὴλ καὶ Ὀζειά·
vulg: Mesizabel Sadoc Ieddua
clem: Mesizabel, Sadoc, Jeddua,
kjv: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

wlc: מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵל צָדוֹק יַדּוּעַ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φασούρ, Ἐλιωνά, Μαασαιὰ καὶ Σαμαὴλ καὶ Ναθαναὴλ καὶ Ἰωζαβὰδ καὶ Ἠλασά·
vulg: Felthia Anan Ania
clem: Pheltia, Hanan, Anaia,
kjv: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

wlc: פְּלַטְיָה חָנָן עֲנָיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευειτῶν Ἰωζαβὰδ καὶ Σαμοὺ καὶ Κωλειά, αὐτὸς Κωλιεύ, καὶ Φαδαιὰ καὶ Ἰοδὸμ καὶ Ἐλιέζερ,
vulg: Osee Anania Asub
clem: Osee, Hanania, Hasub,
kjv: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

wlc: הוֹשֵׁעַ חֲנַנְיָה חַשּׁוּב ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ᾀδόντων Ἐλεισάφ, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πυλωρῶν Γελλὴμ καὶ Τέλημ καὶ Ὠδούθ·
vulg: Aloes Phaleam Sobec
clem: Alohes, Phalea, Sobec,
kjv: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

wlc: הַלּוֹחֵשׁ פִּלְחָא שׁוֹבֵק ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φορός, Ῥαμιὰ καὶ Ἀζειὰ καὶ Μελχειὰ καὶ Ἀμαμεὶν καὶ Ἐλεαζὰρ καὶ Βαναιά·
vulg: Reum Asebna Madsia
clem: Rehum, Hasebna, Maasia,
kjv: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

wlc: רְחוּם חֲשַׁבְנָה מַעֲשֵׂיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἠλάμ, Μαθανιά, Ζαχαριὰ καὶ Ἰαὴλ καὶ Ἀβδειὰ καὶ Ἰαρειμοὶθ καὶ Ἠλειά·
vulg: et Haia Hanam Anan
clem: Echaia, Hanan, Anan,
kjv: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

wlc: וַאֲחִיָּה חָנָן עָנָן ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ζαθουιά, Ἐλιωνά, Ἐλεισούβ, Ἀλαθανιὰ καὶ Ἀμὼν καὶ Ζαβαδὰβ καὶ Ὀζειά·
vulg: Melluc Arem Baana
clem: Melluch, Haran, Baana.
kjv: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

wlc: מַלּוּךְ חָרִם בַּעֲנָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βαβεἰ, Ἰωανάν, Νιανὰ καὶ Ζαβού, Θαλεί·
vulg: et reliqui de populo sacerdotes Levitae ianitores et cantores Nathinnei et omnes qui se separaverunt de populis terrarum ad legem Dei uxores eorum filii eorum et filiae eorum
clem: Et reliqui de populo, sacerdotes, Levit, janitores, et cantores, Nathini, et omnes qui se separaverunt de populis terrarum ad legem Dei, uxores eorum, filii eorum, et fili eorum,
kjv: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;

wlc: וּשְׁאָר הָעָם הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם הַשּׁוֹעֲרִים הַמְשֹׁרְרִים הַנְּתִינִים וְכָל־הַנִּבְדָּל מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת אֶל־תּוֹרַת הָאֱלֹהִים נְשֵׁיהֶם בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם כֹּל יוֹדֵעַ מֵבִין ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βανουεί, Μελουσάμ, Ἀλούμ, Ἀδά, Ἰασοὺδ καὶ Σαλουιὰ καὶ Μημών·
vulg: omnis qui poterat sapere spondentes pro fratribus suis optimates eorum et qui veniebant ad pollicendum et iurandum ut ambularent in lege Dei quam dederat in manu Mosi servi Dei ut facerent et custodirent universa mandata Domini Dei nostri et iudicia eius et caerimonias eius
clem: omnes qui poterant sapere spondentes pro fratribus suis, optimates eorum, et qui veniebant ad pollicendum et jurandum ut ambularent in lege Dei, quam dederat in manu Moysi servi Dei: ut facerent et custodirent universa mandata Domini Dei nostri, et judicia ejus et cremonias ejus:
kjv: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

wlc: מַחֲזִיקִים עַל־אֲחֵיהֶם אַדִּירֵיהֶם וּבָאִים בְּאָלָה וּבִשְׁבוּעָה לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרַת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר נִתְּנָה בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־הָאֱלֹהִים וְלִשְׁמוֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת יְהוָה אֲדֹנֵינוּ וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו וְחֻקָּיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φααδμωάβ, Αἰδαινέ, Καήλ, Βαναία, Μασηά, Μαθανιά, Βεσελὴλ καὶ Θανουεὶ καὶ Μανασσή·
vulg: et ut non daremus filias nostras populo terrae et filias eorum non acciperemus filiis nostris
clem: et ut non daremus filias nostras populo terr, et filias eorum non acciperemus filiis nostris.
kjv: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, not take their daughters for our sons:

wlc: וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא־נִתֵּן בְּנֹתֵינוּ לְעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵיהֶם לֹא נִקַּח לְבָנֵינוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἡράμ, Ἐλειέζερ, Ἰεσσειά, Μελχειά, Σαμαιά, Σεμεών,
vulg: populi quoque terrae qui inportant venalia et omnia ad usum per diem sabbati ut vendant non accipiemus ab eis in sabbato et in die sanctificata et dimittemus annum septimum et exactionem universae manus
clem: Populi quoque terr, qui important venalia, et omnia ad usum, per diem sabbati ut vendant, non accipiemus ab eis in sabbato et in die sanctificato. Et dimittemus annum septimum, et exactionem univers manus.
kjv: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

wlc: וְעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ הַמְבִיאִים אֶת־הַמַּקָּחוֹת וְכָל־שֶׁבֶר בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לִמְכּוֹר לֹא־נִקַּח מֵהֶם בַּשַּׁבָּת וּבְיוֹם קֹדֶשׁ וְנִטֹּשׁ אֶת־הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית וּמַשָּׁא כָל־יָד ׃
lxx: Βενιαμείν, Μαλούχ. Σαμαρειά·
vulg: et statuemus super nos praecepta ut demus tertiam partem sicli per annum ad opus domus Dei nostri
clem: Et statuemus super nos prcepta, ut demus tertiam partem sicli per annum ad opus domus Dei nostri,
kjv: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

wlc: וְהֶעֱמַדְנוּ עָלֵינוּ מִצְוֹת לָתֵת עָלֵינוּ שְׁלִשִׁית הַשֶּׁקֶל בַּשָּׁנָה לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἡσάμ, Μαθανιά, Ἀθά, Ζαβέλ, Ἐλειφάνεθ, Ἰεραμείμ, Μανασσή, Σεμεεί·
vulg: ad panes propositionis et ad sacrificium sempiternum et in holocaustum sempiternum in sabbatis in kalendis in sollemnitatibus et in sanctificatis et pro peccato ut exoretur pro Israhel et in omnem usum domus Dei nostri
clem: ad panes propositionis, et ad sacrificium sempiternum, et in holocaustum sempiternum in sabbatis, in calendis, in solemnitatibus, et in sanctificatis, et pro peccato: ut exoretur pro Isral, et in omnem usum domus Dei nostri.
kjv: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

wlc: לְלֶחֶם הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת וּמִנְחַת הַתָּמִיד וּלְעוֹלַת הַתָּמִיד הַשַּׁבָּתוֹת הֶחֳדָשִׁים לַמּוֹעֲדִים וְלַקֳּדָשִׁים וְלַחַטָּאוֹת לְכַפֵּר עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכֹל מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ ׃ ס
lxx: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἀνεί, Μοδεδειά, Μαρεί, Οὐήλ,
vulg: sortes ergo misimus super oblatione lignorum inter sacerdotes et Levitas et populos ut inferrentur in domum Dei nostri per domos patrum nostrorum per tempora a temporibus anni usque ad annum ut arderent super altare Domini Dei nostri sicut scriptum est in lege Mosi
clem: Sortes ergo misimus super oblationem lignorum inter sacerdotes, et Levitas, et populum, ut inferrentur in domum Dei nostri per domos patrum nostrorum, per tempora, a temporibus anni usque ad annum: ut arderent super altare Domini Dei nostri, sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi:
kjv: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law:

wlc: וְהַגּוֹרָלוֹת הִפַּלְנוּ עַל־קֻרְבַּן הָעֵצִים הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְהָעָם לְהָבִיא לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְבֵית־אֲבֹתֵינוּ לְעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנִים שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה לְבַעֵר עַל־מִזְבַּח יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כַּכָּתוּב בַּתּוֹרָה ׃
lxx: Βαναία, Βαραιά, Χελκειά,
vulg: et ut adferremus primogenita terrae nostrae et primitiva universi fructus omnis ligni ab anno in annum in domo Domini
clem: et ut afferremus primogenita terr nostr, et primitiva universi fructus omnis ligni, ab anno in annum, in domo Domini:
kjv: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the Lord:

wlc: וּלְהָבִיא אֶת־בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתֵנוּ וּבִכּוּרֵי כָּל־פְּרִי כָל־עֵץ שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה לְבֵית יְהוָה ׃
lxx: Οὐιεχωά, Ἰεραμώθ, Ἐλειασείφ,
vulg: et primitiva filiorum nostrorum et pecorum nostrorum sicut scriptum est in lege et primitiva boum nostrorum et ovium nostrarum ut offerrentur in domo Dei nostri sacerdotibus qui ministrant in domo Dei nostri
clem: et primitiva filiorum nostrorum et pecorum nostrorum, sicut sciptum est in lege, et primitiva boum nostrorum et ovium nostrarum, ut offerrentur in domo Dei nostri, sacerdotibus qui ministrant in domo Dei nostri:
kjv: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:

wlc: וְאֶת־בְּכֹרוֹת בָּנֵינוּ וּבְהֶמְתֵּינוּ כַּכָּתוּב בַּתּוֹרָה וְאֶת־בְּכוֹרֵי בְקָרֵינוּ וְצֹאנֵינוּ לְהָבִיא לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ לַכֹּהֲנִים הַמְשָׁרְתִים בְּבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ ׃
lxx: Μαθανιά, Μαθανάν· καὶ ἐποίησαν.
vulg: et primitias ciborum nostrorum et libaminum nostrorum et poma omnis ligni vindemiae quoque et olei adferemus sacerdotibus ad gazofilacium Dei nostri et decimam partem terrae nostrae Levitis ipsi Levitae decimas accipient ex omnibus civitatibus operum nostrorum
clem: et primitias ciborum nostrorum, et libaminum nostrorum, et poma omnis ligni, vindemi quoque et olei, afferemus sacerdotibus ad gazophylacium Dei nostri, et decimam partem terr nostr Levitis. Ipsi Levit decimas accipient ex omnibus civitatibus operum nostrorum.
kjv: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

wlc: וְאֶת־רֵאשִׁית עֲרִיסֹתֵינוּ וּתְרוּמֹתֵינוּ וּפְרִי כָל־עֵץ תִּירוֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר נָבִיא לַכֹּהֲנִים אֶל־לִשְׁכוֹת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ וּמַעְשַׂר אַדְמָתֵנוּ לַלְוִיִּם וְהֵם הַלְוִיִּם הַמְעַשְּׂרִים בְּכֹל עָרֵי עֲבֹדָתֵנוּ ׃
lxx: οἱ υἱοὶ Βανουὶ καὶ υἱοὶ Σεμεεί,
vulg: erit autem sacerdos filius Aaron cum Levitis in decimis Levitarum et Levitae offerent decimam partem decimae suae in domum Dei nostri ad gazofilacium in domo thesauri
clem: Erit autem sacerdos filius Aaron cum Levitis in decimis Levitarum, et Levit offerent decimam partem decim su in domo Dei nostri ad gazophylacium in domum thesauri.
kjv: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.

wlc: וְהָיָה הַכֹּהֵן בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן עִם־הַלְוִיִּם בַּעְשֵׂר הַלְוִיִּם וְהַלְוִיִּם יַעֲלוּ אֶת־מַעֲשַׂר הַמַּעֲשֵׂר לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶל־הַלְּשָׁכוֹת לְבֵית הָאוֹצָר ׃
lxx: καὶ Σελεμιὰ καὶ Ναθὰν καὶ Ἀδαιά,
vulg: ad gazofilacium enim deportabunt filii Israhel et filii Levi primitias frumenti vini et olei et ibi erunt vasa sanctificata et sacerdotes et cantores et ianitores et ministri et non dimittemus domum Dei nostri
clem: Ad gazophylacium enim deportabunt filii Isral, et filii Levi, primitias frumenti, vini, et olei: et ibi erunt vasa sanctificata, et sacerdotes, et cantores, et janitores, et ministri: et non dimittemus domum Dei nostri.
kjv: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.

wlc: כִּי אֶל־הַלְּשָׁכוֹת יָבִיאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנֵי הַלֵּוִי אֶת־תְּרוּמַת הַדָּגָן הַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר וְשָׁם כְּלֵי הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים הַמְשָׁרְתִים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְלֹא נַעֲזֹב אֶת־בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ ׃
lxx: Μαχαδναβού, Σεσεί, Σαριού,
Ἐζερὴλ καὶ Σελεμιὰ καὶ Σαμαρειὰ
καὶ Σαλούμ, Μαρμά, Ἰωσήφ·
ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ναβού, Ἰαήλ. Θαμαθιά, Σεδέμ, Ζανβινά, Διὰ καὶ Ἰωὴλ καὶ Βαναιά. ⁴⁴πάντες οὗτοι ἐλάβοσαν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας, καὶ ἐγέννησαν ἐξ αὐτῶν υἱούς.

wlc: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׂרֵי־הָעָם בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ וּשְׁאָר הָעָם הִפִּילוּ גוֹרָלוֹת לְהָבִיא אֶחָד מִן־הָעֲשָׂרָה לָשֶׁבֶת בִּירוּשָׁלַםִ עִיר הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְתֵשַׁע הַיָּדוֹת בֶּעָרִים ׃
lxx: ΛΟΓΟΙ Νεεμία υἱοῦ Χελκειά. Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μηνὶ Σεχεηλοὺ ἔτους εἰκοστοῦ καὶ ἐγὼ ἤμην ἐν Σουσὰν ἁβειρά·
vulg: habitaverunt autem principes populi in Hierusalem reliqua vero plebs misit sortem ut tollerent unam partem de decem qui habitaturi essent in Hierusalem in civitate sancta novem vero partes in civitatibus
clem: Habitaverunt autem principes populi in Jerusalem: reliqua vero plebs misit sortem, ut tollerent unam partem de decem qui habitaturi essent in Jerusalem civitate sancta, novem vero partes in civitatibus.
kjv: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.

wlc: וַיְבָרֲכוּ הָעָם לְכֹל הָאֲנָשִׁים הַמִּתְנַדְּבִים לָשֶׁבֶת בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἦλθεν Ἁνανὶ εἷς ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου, αὐτὸς καὶ ἄνδρες Ἰούδα, καὶ ἠρώτησα αὐτοὺς περὶ τῶν σωθέντων οἳ κατελίπησαν ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας καὶ περὶ Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: benedixit autem populus omnibus viris qui se sponte obtulerunt ut habitarent in Hierusalem
clem: Benedixit autem populus omnibus viris qui se sponte obtulerant ut habitarent in Jerusalem.
kjv: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי הַמְּדִינָה אֲשֶׁר יָשְׁבוּ בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ וּבְעָרֵי יְהוּדָה יָשְׁבוּ אִישׁ בַּאֲחֻזָּתוֹ בְּעָרֵיהֶם יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְהַנְּתִינִים וּבְנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἴποσαν πρὸς μέ Οἱ καταλειπόμενοι οἱ καταλειφθέντες ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας ἐκεῖ ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ, ἐν πόλει, ἐν πονηρίᾳ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν ὀνειδισμῷ, καὶ τείχη Ἰερουσαλὴμ καθῃρημένα, καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἐνεπρήσθησαν ἐν πυρί.
vulg: hii sunt itaque principes provinciae qui habitaverunt in Hierusalem et in civitatibus Iuda habitavit unusquisque in possessione sua in urbibus suis Israhel sacerdotes Levitae Nathinnei et filii servorum Salomonis
clem: Hi sunt itaque principes provinci qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem, et in civitatibus Juda. Habitavit autem unusquisque in possessione sua, in urbibus suis, Isral, sacerdotes, Levit, Nathini, et filii servorum Salomonis.
kjv: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.

wlc: וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם יָשְׁבוּ מִבְּנֵי יְהוּדָה וּמִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן מִבְּנֵי יְהוּדָה עֲתָיָה בֶן־עֻזִּיָּה בֶּן־זְכַרְיָה בֶן־אֲמַרְיָה בֶּן־שְׁפַטְיָה בֶן־מַהֲלַלְאֵל מִבְּנֵי־פָרֶץ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαί με τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἐκάθισα καὶ ἔκλαυσα καὶ ἐπένθησα ἡμέρας, καὶ ἤμην νηστεύων καὶ προσευχόμενος ἐνώπιον θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
vulg: et in Hierusalem habitaverunt de filiis Iuda et de filiis Beniamin de filiis Iuda Athaias filius Aziam filii Zacchariae filii Amariae filii Saphatia filii Malelehel de filiis Phares
clem: Et in Jerusalem habitaverunt de filiis Juda, et de filiis Benjamin: de filiis Juda, Athaias filius Aziam, filii Zachari, filii Amari, filii Saphati, filii Melaleel: de filiis Phares,
kjv: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

wlc: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָה בֶן־בָּרוּךְ בֶּן־כָּל־חֹזֶה בֶּן־חֲזָיָה בֶן־עֲדָיָה בֶן־יוֹיָרִיב בֶּן־זְכַרְיָה בֶּן־הַשִּׁלֹנִי ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπα Μὴ δή, Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ὁ μέγας καὶ φοβερός, φυλάσσων τὴν διαθήκην καὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτὸν καὶ τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ·
vulg: Imaasia filius Baruch filius Coloza filius Azia filius Adaia filius Ioiarib filius Zacchariae filius Silonites
clem: Maasia filius Baruch, filius Cholhoza, filius Hazia, filius Adaia, filius Jojarib, filius Zachari, filius Silonitis:
kjv: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

wlc: כָּל־בְּנֵי־פֶרֶץ הַיֹּשְׁבִים בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁמֹנָה אַנְשֵׁי־חָיִל ׃ ס
lxx: ἔστω δὴ τὸ οὗς σου προσέχον καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοίσου ἀνεῳγμένοι τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι προσευχὴν δούλου σου, ἣν ἐγὼ προσεύχομαι ἐνώπιόν σου σήμερον ἡμέραν καὶ νύκτα περὶ υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ δούλων σου, καὶ ἐξαγορεύων ἐπὶ ἁμαρτίαις υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἂς ἡμάρτομέν σοι, καὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ οἶκος πατρός μου ἡμάρτομεν.
vulg: omnes filii Phares qui habitaverunt in Hierusalem quadringenti sexaginta octo viri fortes
clem: omnes hi filii Phares, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem, quadringenti sexaginta octo viri fortes.
kjv: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן סַלֻּא בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־יוֹעֵד בֶּן־פְּדָיָה בֶן־קוֹלָיָה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָה בֶּן־אִיתִיאֵל בֶּן־יְשַׁעְיָה ׃
lxx: διαλύσει διελύσαμεν, καὶ οὐκ ἐφυλάξαμεν τὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ τὰ προστάγματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ἃ ἐνετείλω τῷ Μωυσῇ παιδί σου.
vulg: hii sunt autem filii Beniamin Sellum filius Mosollam filius Ioed filius Phadaia filius Colaia filius Masia filius Ethehel filius Isaia
clem: Hi sunt autem filii Benjamin: Sellum filius Mosollam, filius Jod, filius Phadaia, filius Colaia, filius Masia, filius Etheel, filius Isaia,
kjv: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

wlc: וְאַחֲרָיו גַּבַּי סַלָּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה ׃
lxx: μνήσθητι δὴ τὸν λόγον ὃν ἐνετείλω τῷ Μωυσῇ παιδί σου λέγων Ὑμεῖς ἐὰν ἀσυνθετήσητε, ἐγὼ διασκορπιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς·
vulg: et post eum Gabbai Sellai nongenti viginti octo
clem: et post eum Gebbai, Sellai, nongenti viginti octo,
kjv: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

wlc: וְיוֹאֵל בֶּן־זִכְרִי פָּקִיד עֲלֵיהֶם וִיהוּדָה בֶן־הַסְּנוּאָה עַל־הָעִיר מִשְׁנֶה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψητε πρὸς μέ, καὶ φυλάξητε τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ ποιήσητε αὐτάς, ἐὰν ᾖ ἡ διασπορὰ ὑμῶν ἀπʼ ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἐκεῖθεν συνάξω αὐτούς, καὶ εἰσάξω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἐξελεξάμην κατασκηνῶσαι τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐκεῖ
vulg: et Iohel filius Zechri praepositus eorum et Iuda filius Sennua super civitatem secundus
clem: et Jol filius Zechri prpositus eorum, et Judas filius Senua super civitatem secundus.
kjv: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.

wlc: פ מִן־הַכֹּהֲנִים יְדַעְיָה בֶן־יוֹיָרִיב יָכִין ׃
lxx: καὶ αὐτοὶ παῖδές σου καὶ λαός σου, οὓς ἐλυτρώσω ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου τῇ μεγάλη καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου τῇ κραταιᾷ.
vulg: et de sacerdotibus Idaia filius Ioarib Iachin
clem: Et de sacerdotibus, Idaia filius Joarib, Jachin,
kjv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

wlc: שְׂרָיָה בֶן־חִלְקִיָּה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּם בֶּן־צָדוֹק בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב נְגִד בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: μὴ δή, ἀλλ᾿ ἔστω τὸ οὖς σου προσέχον εἰς τὴν προσευχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου καὶ εἰς τὴν προσευχὴν παίδων σου τῶν θελόντων φοβεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομά σου· καὶ εὐόδωσον δὴ τῷ παιδί σου σήμερον καὶ δὸς αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκτειρμοὺς ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τούτου. καὶ ἐγὼ ἤμην εὐνοῦχος τῷ βασιλεῖ.
vulg: Saraia filius Elcia filius Mesollam filius Sadoc filius Meraioth filius Ahitub princeps domus Dei
clem: Saraia filius Helci, filius Mosollam, filius Sadoc, filius Meraioth, filius Achitob princeps domus Dei,
kjv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.

wlc: וַאֲחֵיהֶם עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה לַבַּיִת שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנָיִם וַעֲדָיָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם בֶּן־פְּלַלְיָה בֶּן־אַמְצִי בֶן־זְכַרְיָה בֶּן־פַּשְׁחוּר בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּה ׃
vulg: et fratres eorum facientes opera templi octingenti viginti duo et Adaia filius Ieroam filius Felelia filius Amsi filius Zacchariae filius Phessur filius Melchiae
clem: et fratres eorum facientes opera templi: octingenti viginti duo. Et Adaia filius Jeroham, filius Phelelia, filius Amsi, filius Zachari, filius Pheshur, filius Melchi,
kjv: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah.

wlc: וְאֶחָיו רָאשִׁים לְאָבוֹת מָאתַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנָיִם וַעֲמַשְׁסַי בֶּן־עֲזַרְאֵל בֶּן־אַחְזַי בֶּן־מְשִׁלֵּמוֹת בֶּן־אִמֵּר ׃
vulg: et fratres eius principes patrum ducenti quadraginta duo et Amassai filius Azrihel filius Aazi filius Mosollamoth filius Emmer
clem: et fratres ejus principes patrum: ducenti quadraginta duo. Et Amassai filius Azreel, filius Ahazi, filius Mosollamoth, filius Emmer,
kjv: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

wlc: וַאֲחֵיהֶם גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה וּפָקִיד עֲלֵיהֶם זַבְדִּיאֵל בֶּן־הַגְּדוֹלִים ׃ ס
vulg: et fratres eorum potentes nimis centum viginti octo et praepositus eorum Zabdihel filius potentium
clem: et fratres eorum potentes nimis: centum viginti octo, et prpositus eorum Zabdiel filius potentium.
kjv: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.

wlc: וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּם שְׁמַעְיָה בֶן־חַשּׁוּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָה בֶּן־בּוּנִּי ׃
vulg: et de Levitis Sebenia filius Asob filius Azaricam filius Asabia filius Boni
clem: Et de Levitis, Semeia filius Hasub, filius Azaricam, filius Hasabia, filius Boni,
kjv: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

wlc: וְשַׁבְּתַי וְיוֹזָבָד עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה הַחִיצֹנָה לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים מֵרָאשֵׁי הַלְוִיִּם ׃
vulg: et Sabathai et Iozabed super opera quae erant forinsecus in domo Dei a principibus Levitarum
clem: et Sabathai et Jozabed, super omnia opera qu erant forinsecus in domo Dei, a principibus Levitarum.
kjv: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

wlc: וּמַתַּנְיָה בֶן־מִיכָה בֶּן־זַבְדִּי בֶן־אָסָף רֹאשׁ הַתְּחִלָּה יְהוֹדֶה לַתְּפִלָּה וּבַקְבֻּקְיָה מִשְׁנֶה מֵאֶחָיו וְעַבְדָּא בֶּן־שַׁמּוּעַ בֶּן־גָּלָל בֶּן־יְדִיתוּן ׃
vulg: et Mathania filius Micha filius Zebdaei filius Asaph princeps ad laudandum et confitendum in oratione et Becbecia secundus de fratribus eius et Abda filius Sammua filius Galal filius Idithun
clem: Et Mathania filius Micha, filius Zebedei, filius Asaph, princeps ad laudandum et ad confitendum in oratione, et Becbecia secundus de fratribus ejus, et Abda filius Samua, filius Galal, filius Idithun:
kjv: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

wlc: כָּל־הַלְוִיִּם בְּעִיר הַקֹּדֶשׁ מָאתַיִם שְׁמֹנִים וְאַרְבָּעָה ׃ פ
vulg: omnes Levitae in civitate sancta ducenti octoginta quattuor
clem: omnes Levit in civitate sancta ducenti octoginta quatuor.
kjv: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.

wlc: וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים עַקּוּב טַלְמוֹן וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַשֹּׁמְרִים בַּשְּׁעָרִים מֵאָה שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁנָיִם ׃
vulg: et ianitores Accob Telmon et fratres eorum qui custodiebant ostia centum septuaginta duo
clem: Et janitores, Accub, Telmon, et fratres eorum, qui custodiebant ostia: centum septuaginta duo.
kjv: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.

wlc: וּשְׁאָר יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם בְּכָל־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתוֹ ׃
vulg: et reliqui ex Israhel sacerdotes et Levitae in universis civitatibus Iuda unusquisque in possessione sua
clem: Et reliqui ex Isral sacerdotes et Levit in universis civitatibus Juda, unusquisque in possessione sua.
kjv: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

wlc: וְהַנְּתִינִים יֹשְׁבִים בָּעֹפֶל וְצִיחָא וְגִשְׁפָּא עַל־הַנְּתִינִים ׃ פ
vulg: et Nathinnei qui habitabant in Ofel et Siaha et Gaspha de Nathinneis
clem: Et Nathini, qui habitabant in Ophel, et Siaha, et Gaspha de Nathinis.
kjv: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.

wlc: וּפְקִיד הַלְוִיִּם בִּירוּשָׁלַםִ עֻזִּי בֶן־בָּנִי בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָה בֶּן־מִיכָא מִבְּנֵי אָסָף הַמְשֹׁרְרִים לְנֶגֶד מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים ׃
vulg: et episcopus Levitarum in Hierusalem Azzi filius Bani filius Asabiae filius Matthaniae filius Michae de filiis Asaph cantores in ministerio domus Dei
clem: Et episcopus Levitarum in Jerusalem, Azzi filius Bani, filius Hasabi, filius Mathani, filius Mich. De filiis Asaph, cantores in ministerio domus Dei.
kjv: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.

wlc: כִּי־מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶם וַאֲמָנָה עַל־הַמְשֹׁרְרִים דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ ׃
vulg: praeceptum quippe regis super eos erat et ordo in cantoribus per dies singulos
clem: Prceptum quippe regis super eos erat, et ordo in cantoribus per dies singulos,
kjv: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

wlc: וּפְתַחְיָה בֶּן־מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵל מִבְּנֵי־זֶרַח בֶּן־יְהוּדָה לְיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ לְכָל־דָּבָר לָעָם ׃
vulg: et Fataia filius Mesezebel de filiis Zera filii Iuda in manu regis iuxta omne verbum populi
clem: et Phathahia filius Mesezebel, de filiis Zara filii Juda in manu regis, juxta omne verbum populi,
kjv: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

wlc: וְאֶל־הַחֲצֵרִים בִּשְׂדֹתָם מִבְּנֵי יְהוּדָה יָשְׁבוּ בְּקִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וּבְדִיבֹן וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וּבִיקַּבְצְאֵל וַחֲצֵרֶיהָ ׃
vulg: et in domibus per omnes regiones eorum de filiis Iuda habitaverunt in Cariatharbe et in filiabus eius et in Dibon et in filiabus eius et in Capsel et in viculis eius
clem: et in domibus per omnes regiones eorum. De filiis Juda habitaverunt in Cariatharbe et in filiabus ejus: et in Dibon, et in filiabus ejus: et in Cabseel, et in viculis ejus:
kjv: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,

wlc: וּבְיֵשׁוּעַ וּבְמוֹלָדָה וּבְבֵית פָּלֶט ׃
vulg: et in Iesue et in Molada et in Bethfaleth
clem: et in Jesue, et in Molada, et in Bethphaleth,
kjv: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Bethphelet,

wlc: וּבַחֲצַר שׁוּעָל וּבִבְאֵר שֶׁבַע וּבְנֹתֶיהָ ׃
vulg: et in Asersual et in Bersabee et in filiabus eius
clem: et in Hasersual, et in Bersabee, et in filiabus ejus,
kjv: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and in the villages thereof,

wlc: וּבְצִקְלַג וּבִמְכֹנָה וּבִבְנֹתֶיהָ ׃
vulg: et in Siceleg et in Mochona et in filiabus eius
clem: et in Siceleg, et in Mochona, et in filiabus ejus,
kjv: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

wlc: וּבְעֵין רִמּוֹן וּבְצָרְעָה וּבְיַרְמוּת ׃
vulg: et in Ainremmon et in Sara et in Irimuth
clem: et in Remmon, et in Saraa, et in Jerimuth,
kjv: And at Enrimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

wlc: זָנֹחַ עֲדֻלָּם וְחַצְרֵיהֶם לָכִישׁ וּשְׂדֹתֶיהָ עֲזֵקָה וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וַיַּחֲנוּ מִבְּאֵר־שֶׁבַע עַד־גֵּיא־הִנֹּם ׃
vulg: Zanoa Odollam et villis earum Lachis et regionibus eius Azeca et filiabus eius et manserunt in Bersabee usque ad vallem Ennom
clem: Zanoa, Odollam, et in villis earum, Lachis et regionibus ejus, et Azeca, et filiabus ejus. Et manserunt in Bersabee usque ad vallem Ennom.
kjv: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

wlc: וּבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן מִגָּבַע מִכְמָשׂ וְעַיָּה וּבֵית־אֵל וּבְנֹתֶיהָ ׃
vulg: filii autem Beniamin a Geba Mechmas et Aia et Bethel et filiabus eius
clem: Filii autem Benjamin, a Geba, Mechmas, et Hai, et Bethel, et filiabus ejus
kjv: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages.

wlc: עֲנָתוֹת נֹב עֲנָנְיָה ׃
vulg: Anathoth Nob Anania
clem: Anathoth, Nob, Anania,
kjv: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

wlc: חָצוֹר רָמָה גִּתָּיִם ׃
vulg: Asor Rama Getthaim
clem: Asor, Rama, Gethaim,
kjv: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

wlc: חָדִיד צְבֹעִים נְבַלָּט ׃
vulg: Adid Seboim Neballa Loth
clem: Hadid, Seboim, et Neballat, Lod,
kjv: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

wlc: לֹד וְאוֹנוֹ גֵּי הַחֲרָשִׁים ׃
vulg: et Ono valle Artificum
clem: et Ono valle artificum.
kjv: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

wlc: וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּם מַחְלְקוֹת יְהוּדָה לְבִנְיָמִין ׃ פ
vulg: et de Levitis partitiones Iuda et Beniamin
clem: Et de Levitis portiones Jud et Benjamin.
kjv: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ שְׂרָיָה יִרְמְיָה עֶזְרָא ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μηνὶ Νισὰν ἔτους εἰκοστοῦ Ἀρσαθερθὰ βασιλεῖ καὶ ἦν οἶνος ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ, καὶ ἔλαβον τὸν οἶνον καὶ ἔδωκα τῷ βασιλεῖ, καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἕτερος ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ,
vulg: hii autem sacerdotes et Levitae qui ascenderunt cum Zorobabel filio Salathihel et Iosue Saraia Hieremias Ezra
clem: Hi sunt autem sacerdotes et Levit, qui ascenderunt cum Zorobabel filio Salathiel, et Josue: Saraia, Jeremias, Esdras,
kjv: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

wlc: אֲמַרְיָה מַלּוּךְ חַטּוּשׁ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ βασιλεύς Διὰ τί τὸ πρόσωπόν σου πονηρόν, καὶ οὐκ εἶ μετριάζων; οὐκ ἔστιν τοῦτο εἰ μὴ πονηρία καρδίας. καὶ ἐφοβήθην πολὺ σφόδρα,
vulg: Amaria Melluch Attus
clem: Amaria, Melluch, Hattus,
kjv: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

wlc: שְׁכַנְיָה רְחֻם מְרֵמֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπα τῷ βασιλεῖ Ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ζήτω. διὰ τί οὐ μὴ γένηται πονηρὸν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου, διότι ἡ πόλις, οἶκος μνημείων πατέρων μου, ἠρημώθη καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς κατεβρώθησαν ἐν πυρί;
vulg: Sechenia Reum Meremuth
clem: Sebenias, Rheum, Merimuth,
kjv: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

wlc: עִדּוֹא גִנְּתוֹי אֲבִיָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ βασιλεύς Περὶ τίνος τοῦτο συνζητεῖς; καὶ προσηυξάμην πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,
vulg: Addo Genthon Abia
clem: Addo, Genthon, Abia,
kjv: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

wlc: מִיָּמִין מַעַדְיָה בִּלְגָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπα τῷ βασιλεῖ Εἰ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθόν, καὶ εἰ ἀγαθυνθήσεται ὁ παῖς σου ἐνώπιόν σου ὥστε πέμψαι αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰουδά, εἰς πόλιν μνημείων πατέρων μου, καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσω αὐτήν.
vulg: Miamin Madia Belga
clem: Miamin, Madia, Belga,
kjv: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

wlc: שְׁמַעְיָה וְיוֹיָרִיב יְדַעְיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἡ παλλακὴ ἡ καθημένη ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ Ἕως πότε ἔσται ἡ πορεία σου, καὶ πότε ἐπιστρέψεις; καὶ ἠγαθύνθη ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως, καὶ ἀπέστειλέν με, καὶ ἔδαωκα αὐτῷ ὄρον.
vulg: Semaia et Ioarib Idaia Sellum Amoc Elceia
clem: Semeia, et Jojarib, Idaia, Sellum, Amoc, Helcias,
kjv: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

wlc: סַלּוּ עָמוֹק חִלְקִיָּה יְדַעְיָה אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי הַכֹּהֲנִים וַאֲחֵיהֶם בִּימֵי יֵשׁוּעַ ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ εἶπα τῷ βασιλεῖ Εἰ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθόν, ἐπιστολὰς δότω μοι πρὸς τοὺς ἐπάρχους πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ, ὥστε παραγαγεῖν με ἕως ἔλθω ἐπὶ Ἰουδά,
vulg: Idaia isti principes sacerdotum et fratres eorum in diebus Iosue
clem: Idaia. Isti principes sacerdotum, et fratres eorum in diebus Josue.
kjv: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

wlc: וְהַלְוִיִּם יֵשׁוּעַ בִּנּוּי קַדְמִיאֵל שֵׁרֵבְיָה יְהוּדָה מַתַּנְיָה עַל־הֻיְּדוֹת הוּא וְאֶחָיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπιστολὴν ἐπὶ Ἀσὰφ φύλακα τοῦ παραδείσου ὅς ἐστιν τῷ βασιλεῖ, ὥστε δοῦναί μοι ξύλα στεγάσαι τὰς πύλας καὶ εἰς τὸ τεῖχος τῆς πόλεως καὶ εἰς οἶκον ὃν εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς αὐτόν. καὶ ἔδωκέν μοι ὁ βασιλεύς, ὡς χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡ ἀγαθή.
vulg: porro Levitae Iesua Bennui Cedmihel Sarabia Iuda Mathanias super hymnos ipsi et fratres eorum
clem: Porro Levit, Jesua, Bennui, Cedmihel, Sarebia, Juda, Mathanias, super hymnos ipsi et fratres eorum:
kjv: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

wlc: וּבַקְבֻּקְיָה וְעֻנּוֹ אֲחֵיהֶם לְנֶגְדָּם לְמִשְׁמָרוֹת ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τοὺς ἐπάρχους πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ, καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς τὰς ἐπιστολὰς τοῦ βασιλέως· καὶ ἀπέστειλεν μετʼ ἐμοῦ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἀρχηγοὺς δυνάμεως καὶ ἱππεῖς.
vulg: et Becbecia atque et Hanni fratres eorum unusquisque in officio suo
clem: et Becbecia atque Hanni, et fratres eorum, unusquisque in officio suo.
kjv: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.

wlc: וְיֵשׁוּעַ הוֹלִיד אֶת־יוֹיָקִים וְיוֹיָקִים הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֶלְיָשִׁיב וְאֶלְיָשִׁיב אֶת־יוֹיָדָע ׃
lxx: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαναβαλλὰτ Ἁρωνεί, καὶ πονηρὸν αὐτοῖς ἐγένετο ὅτι ἥκει ἄνθρανπος ζητῆσαι ἀγαθὸν τοῖς υἱρῖς Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: Hiesue autem genuit Ioachim et Ioachim genuit Eliasib et Eliasib genuit Ioiada
clem: Josue autem genuit Joacim, et Joacim genuit Eliasib, et Eliasib genuit Jojada,
kjv: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

wlc: וְיוֹיָדָע הוֹלִיד אֶת־יוֹנָתָן וְיוֹנָתָן הוֹלִיד אֶת־יַדּוּעַ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ ἤμην ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας τρεῖς.
vulg: et Ioiada genuit Ionathan et Ionathan genuit Ieddoa
clem: et Jojada genuit Jonathan, et Jonathan genuit Jeddoa.
kjv: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

wlc: וּבִימֵי יוֹיָקִים הָיוּ כֹהֲנִים רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לִשְׂרָיָה מְרָיָה לְיִרְמְיָה חֲנַנְיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστην νυκτὸς ἐγὼ καὶ ἄνδρες ὀλίγοι μετʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἀπήγγειλα ἀνθρώπῳ τί ὁ θεὸς δίδωσιν εἰς καρδίαν μου τοῦ ποιῆσαι μετὰ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ κτῆνος οὐκ ἔστιν μετʼ ἐμοῦ εἰ μὴ τὸ κτῆνος ᾧ ἐγὼ ἐπιβαίνω ἐπʼ αὐτῷ.
vulg: in diebus autem Ioachim erant sacerdotes principes familiarum Saraiae Amaria Hieremiae Anania
clem: In diebus autem Joacim erant sacerdotes et principes familiarum: Sarai, Maraia: Jeremi, Hanania:
kjv: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

wlc: לְעֶזְרָא מְשֻׁלָּם לַאֲמַרְיָה יְהוֹחָנָן ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξῆλθον ἐν πύλῃ τοῦ γωληλὰ καὶ πρὸς στόμα πηγῆς τῶν συκῶν καὶ εἰς πύλην τῆς κοπρίας· καὶ ἤμην συντρίβων ἐν τῷ τείχει Ἰερουσαλὴμ ὃ αὐτοὶ καθαιροῦσιν, καὶ πύλαι αὐτῆς κατεβρώθησαν πυρί.
vulg: Ezrae Mosollam Amariae Iohanan
clem: Esdr, Mosollam: Amari, Johanan:
kjv: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

wlc: לִמְלוּכִי יוֹנָתָן לִשְׁבַנְיָה יוֹסֵף ׃
lxx: καὶ παρῆλθον ἐπὶ πύλην τοῦ Αἰνὰ καὶ εἰς κολυμβήθραν τοῦ βασιλέως, καὶ οὐκ ἦν τόπος τῷ κτήνει παρελθεῖν ὑποκάτω μου.
vulg: Milico Ionathan Sebeniae Ioseph
clem: Milicho, Jonathan: Sebeni, Joseph:
kjv: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

wlc: לְחָרִם עַדְנָא לִמְרָיוֹת חֶלְקָי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἤμην ἀναβαίνων ἐν τῷ τείχει χειμάρρους νυκτός, καὶ ἤμην συντρίβων ἐν τῷ τείχει· καὶ ἤμην ἐν πύλῃ τῆς φάραγγος, καὶ ἐπέστρεψα.
vulg: Arem Edna Maraioth Elci
clem: Haram, Edna: Maraioth, Helci:
kjv: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

wlc: לַעֲדָיָא זְכַרְיָה לְגִנְּתוֹן מְשֻׁלָּם ׃
lxx: καὶ οἱ φυλάσσοντες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τί ἐπορεύθην καὶ τί ἐγὼ ποιῶ· καὶ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις καὶ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς ἐντίμοις καὶ τοῖς καταλοίποις τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔργα ἔως τότε οὐκ ἀπήγγειλα.
vulg: Addaiae Zaccharia Genthon Mosollam
clem: Adai, Zacharia: Genthon, Mosollam:
kjv: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

wlc: לַאֲבִיָּה זִכְרִי לְמִנְיָמִין לְמוֹעַדְיָה פִּלְטָי ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ὑμεῖς βλέπετε τὴν πονηρίαν ἐν ᾗ ἐσμεν ἐν αὐτῇ, πῶς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἔρημος καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἐδόθησαν πυρί· δεῦτε καὶ διοικοδομήσωμεν τὸ τεῖχος Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ οὐκ ἐσόμεθα ἔτι ὄνειδος.
vulg: Abiae Zecheri Miamin et Moadiae Felti
clem: Abi, Zechri: Miamin et Moadi, Phelti:
kjv: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai:

wlc: לְבִלְגָּה שַׁמּוּעַ לִשְׁמַעְיָה יְהוֹנָתָן ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπήγγειλα αὐτοῖς τὴν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ ἥ ἐστιν ἀγαθὴ ἐπʼ ἐμέ, καὶ πρὸς λόγους τοῦ βασιλέως σὓς εἶπέν μοι· καὶ εἶπα Ἀναστῶμεν καὶ οἰκοδομήσωμεν. καὶ ἐκραταιώθησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτῶν εἰς ἀγαθόν.
vulg: Belgae Sammua Semaiae Ionathan
clem: Belg, Sammua: Semai, Jonathan:
kjv: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

wlc: וּלְיוֹיָרִיב מַתְּנַי לִידַעְיָה עֻזִּי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαναβαλλὰτ ὁ Ἁρωνεὶ καὶ Τωβιὰ ὁ δοῦλος Ἀμμωνεὶ καὶ Γῆσαμ ὁ Ἀραβεί, καὶ ἐξεγέλασαν ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἦλθον ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς καὶ εἶπαν Τί τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε ; ἢ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ὑμεῖς ἀποστατεῖτε ;
vulg: Ioiarib Matthanai Iadaiae Azzi
clem: Jojarib, Mathanai: Jodai, Azzi:
kjv: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

wlc: לְסַלַּי קַלָּי לְעָמוֹק עֵבֶר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπέστρεψα αὐτοῖς λόγον καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς Ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, αὐτὸς εὐοδώσει ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἡμεῖς δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ καθαροί, καὶ οἰκοδομήσωμεν· καὶ ὑμῖν οὐκ ἔστιν μερὶς καὶ δικαιοσύνη καὶ μνημόσυνον ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: Sellaiae Celai Amoc Eber
clem: Sellai, Celai: Amoc, Heber:
kjv: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

wlc: לְחִלְקִיָּה חֲשַׁבְיָה לִידַעְיָה נְתַנְאֵל ׃
vulg: Elciae Asebia Idaiae Nathanahel
clem: Helci, Hasebia: Idai, Nathanal.
kjv: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

wlc: הַלְוִיִּם בִּימֵי אֶלְיָשִׁיב יוֹיָדָע וְיוֹחָנָן וְיַדּוּעַ כְּתוּבִים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת וְהַכֹּהֲנִים עַל־מַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַפָּרְסִי ׃ פ
vulg: Levitae in diebus Eliasib et Ioiada et Ionan et Ieddoa scripti principes familiarum et sacerdotes in regno Darii Persae
clem: Levit in diebus Eliasib, et Jojada, et Johanan, et Jeddoa, scripti principes familiarum, et sacerdotes in regno Darii Pers.
kjv: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

wlc: בְּנֵי לֵוִי רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים וְעַד־יְמֵי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁיב ׃
vulg: filii Levi principes familiarum scripti in libro verborum dierum et usque ad dies Ionathan filii Eliasib
clem: Filii Levi principes familiarum, scripti in libro verborum dierum, et usque ad dies Jonathan, filii Eliasib.
kjv: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

wlc: וְרָאשֵׁי הַלְוִיִּם חֲשַׁבְיָה שֵׁרֵבְיָה וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־קַדְמִיאֵל וַאֲחֵיהֶם לְנֶגְדָּם לְהַלֵּל לְהוֹדוֹת בְּמִצְוַת דָּוִיד אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים מִשְׁמָר לְעֻמַּת מִשְׁמָר ׃
vulg: et principes Levitarum Asebia Serebia et Iesue filius Cedmihel et fratres eorum per vices suas ut laudarent et confiterentur iuxta praeceptum David viri Dei et observarent aeque per ordinem
clem: Et principes Levitarum, Hasebia, Serebia, et Josue filius Cedmihel: et fratres eorum per vices suas, ut laudarent et confiterentur juxta prceptum David viri Dei, et observarent que per ordinem.
kjv: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

wlc: מַתַּנְיָה וּבַקְבֻּקְיָה עֹבַדְיָה מְשֻׁלָּם טַלְמוֹן עַקּוּב שֹׁמְרִים שׁוֹעֲרִים מִשְׁמָר בַּאֲסֻפֵּי הַשְּׁעָרִים ׃
vulg: Matthania et Becbecia Obedia Mosollam Thelmon Accub custodes portarum et vestibulorum ante portas
clem: Mathania, et Becbecia, Obedia, Mosollam, Telmon, Accub, custodes portarum et vestibulorum ante portas.
kjv: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

wlc: אֵלֶּה בִּימֵי יוֹיָקִים בֶּן־יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וּבִימֵי נְחֶמְיָה הַפֶּחָה וְעֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן הַסּוֹפֵר ׃ פ
vulg: hii in diebus Ioachim filii Iesue filii Iosedech et in diebus Neemiae ducis et Ezrae sacerdotis scribaeque
clem: Hi in diebus Joacim filii Josue, filii Josedec, et in diebus Nehemi ducis, et Esdr sacerdotis scribque.
kjv: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

wlc: וּבַחֲנֻכַּת חוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלַםִ בִּקְשׁוּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִכָּל־מְקוֹמֹתָם לַהֲבִיאָם לִירוּשָׁלִָם לַעֲשֹׂת חֲנֻכָּה וְשִׂמְחָה וּבְתוֹדוֹת וּבְשִׁיר מְצִלְתַּיִם נְבָלִים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת ׃
vulg: in dedicatione autem muri Hierusalem requisierunt Levitas de omnibus locis suis ut adducerent eos in Hierusalem et facerent dedicationem et laetitiam in actione gratiarum et in cantico in cymbalis psalteriis et citharis
clem: In dedicatione autem muri Jerusalem, requisierunt Levitas de omnibus locis suis ut adducerent eos in Jerusalem, et facerent dedicationem et ltitiam in actione gratiarum, et cantico, et in cymbalis, psalteriis, et citharis.
kjv: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

wlc: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְּנֵי הַמְשֹׁרְרִים וּמִן־הַכִּכָּר סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלַםִ וּמִן־חַצְרֵי נְטֹפָתִי ׃
vulg: congregati sunt ergo filii cantorum et de campestribus circa Hierusalem et de villis Netuphati
clem: Congregati sunt autem filii cantorum de campestribus circa Jerusalem, et de villis Nethuphathi,
kjv: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

wlc: וּמִבֵּית הַגִּלְגָּל וּמִשְּׂדוֹת גֶּבַע וְעַזְמָוֶת כִּי חֲצֵרִים בָּנוּ לָהֶם הַמְשֹׁרֲרִים סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם ׃
vulg: et de domo Galgal et de regionibus Geba et Azmaveth quoniam villas aedificaverunt sibi cantores in circuitu Hierusalem
clem: et de domo Galgal, et de regionibus Geba et Azmaveth: quoniam villas dificaverunt sibi cantores in circuitu Jerusalem.
kjv: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.

wlc: וַיִּטַּהֲרוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וַיְטַהֲרוּ אֶת־הָעָם וְאֶת־הַשְּׁעָרִים וְאֶת־הַחוֹמָה ׃
vulg: et mundati sunt sacerdotes et Levitae et mundaverunt populum et portas et murum
clem: Et mundati sunt sacerdotes et Levit, et mundaverunt populum, et portas, et murum.
kjv: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

wlc: וָאַעֲלֶה אֶת־שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה מֵעַל לַחוֹמָה וָאַעֲמִידָה שְׁתֵּי תוֹדֹת גְּדוֹלֹת וְתַהֲלֻכֹת לַיָּמִין מֵעַל לַחוֹמָה לְשַׁעַר הָאַשְׁפֹּת ׃
vulg: ascendere autem feci principes Iuda super murum et statui duos choros laudantium magnos et ierunt ad dexteram super murum ad portam Sterquilinii
clem: Ascendere autem feci principes Juda super murum, et statui duos magnos choros laudantium. Et ierunt ad dexteram super murum ad portam sterquilinii.
kjv: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

wlc: וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶם הוֹשַׁעְיָה וַחֲצִי שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה ׃
vulg: et ivit post eos Osaias et media pars principum Iuda
clem: Et ivit post eos Osaias, et media pars principum Juda,
kjv: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

wlc: וַעֲזַרְיָה עֶזְרָא וּמְשֻׁלָּם ׃
vulg: et Azarias Ezras et Mosollam Iuda et Beniamin et Semeia et Hieremia
clem: et Azarias, Esdras, et Mosollam, Judas, et Benjamin, et Semeia, et Jeremias.
kjv: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

wlc: יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן וּשְׁמַעְיָה וְיִרְמְיָה ׃ ס
vulg: et de filiis sacerdotum in tubis Zaccharias filius Ionathan filius Semeiae filius Mathaniae filius Michaiae filius Zecchur filius Asaph
clem: Et de filiis sacerdotum in tubis, Zacharias filius Jonathan, filius Semei, filius Mathani, filius Michai, filius Zechur, filius Asaph,
kjv: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

wlc: וּמִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת זְכַרְיָה בֶן־יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שְׁמַעְיָה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָה בֶּן־מִיכָיָה בֶּן־זַכּוּר בֶּן־אָסָף ׃
vulg: et fratres eius Semeia et Azarel Malalai Galalai Maai Nathanel et Iuda et Anani in vasis cantici David viri Dei et Ezras scriba ante eos in porta Fontis
clem: et fratres ejus Semeia, et Azareel, Malalai, Galalai, Maai, Nathanal, et Judas, et Hanani, in vasis cantici David viri Dei: et Esdras scriba ante eos in porta fontis.
kjv: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

wlc: וְאֶחָיו שְׁמַעְיָה וַעֲזַרְאֵל מִלֲלַי גִּלֲלַי מָעַי נְתַנְאֵל וִיהוּדָה חֲנָנִי בִּכְלֵי־שִׁיר דָּוִיד אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְעֶזְרָא הַסּוֹפֵר לִפְנֵיהֶם ׃
vulg: et contra eos ascenderunt in gradibus civitatis David in ascensu muri super domum David et usque ad portam Aquarum ad orientem
clem: Et contra eos ascenderunt in gradibus civitatis David in ascensu muri super domum David, et usque ad portam aquarum ad orientem.
kjv: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

wlc: וְעַל שַׁעַר הָעַיִן וְנֶגְדָּם עָלוּ עַל־מַעֲלוֹת עִיר דָּוִיד בַּמַּעֲלֶה לַחוֹמָה מֵעַל לְבֵית דָּוִיד וְעַד שַׁעַר הַמַּיִם מִזְרָח ׃
vulg: et chorus secundus gratias referentium ibat ex adverso et ego post eum et media pars populi super murum et super turrem Furnorum et usque ad murum latissimum
clem: Et chorus secundus gratias referentium ibat ex adverso, et ego post eum, et media pars populi super murum, et super turrim furnorum, et usque ad murum latissimum,
kjv: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

wlc: וְהַתּוֹדָה הַשֵּׁנִית הַהוֹלֶכֶת לְמוֹאל וַאֲנִי אַחֲרֶיהָ וַחֲצִי הָעָם מֵעַל לְהַחוֹמָה מֵעַל לְמִגְדַּל הַתַּנּוּרִים וְעַד הַחוֹמָה הָרְחָבָה ׃
vulg: et super portam Ephraim et super portam Antiquam et super portam Piscium et turrem Ananehel et turrem Ema et usque ad portam Gregis et steterunt in porta Custodiae
clem: et super portam Ephraim, et super portam antiquam, et super portam piscium et turrim Hananeel, et turrim Emath, et usque ad portam gregis: et steterunt in porta custodi,
kjv: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;

wlc: וּמֵעַל לְשַׁעַר־אֶפְרַיִם וְעַל־שַׁעַר הַיְשָׁנָה וְעַל־שַׁעַר הַדָּגִים וּמִגְדַּל חֲנַנְאֵל וּמִגְדַּל הַמֵּאָה וְעַד שַׁעַר הַצֹּאן וְעָמְדוּ בְּשַׁעַר הַמַּטָּרָה ׃
vulg: steteruntque duo chori laudantium in domo Dei et ego et dimidia pars magistratuum mecum
clem: steteruntque duo chori laudantium in domo Dei, et ego, et dimidia pars magistratuum mecum.
kjv: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

wlc: וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה שְׁתֵּי הַתּוֹדֹת בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲנִי וַחֲצִי הַסְּגָנִים עִמִּי ׃
vulg: et sacerdotes Eliachim Maasia Miniamin Michea Elioenai Zaccharia Anania in tubis
clem: Et sacerdotes, Eliachim, Maasia, Miamin, Michea, Elionai, Zacharia, Hanania in tubis,
kjv: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

wlc: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים אֶלְיָקִים מַעֲשֵׂיָה מִנְיָמִין מִיכָיָה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי זְכַרְיָה חֲנַנְיָה בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת ׃
vulg: et Maasia et Semea et Eleazar et Azi et Iohanan et Melchia et Elam et Ezer et clare cecinerunt cantores et Iezraia praepositus
clem: et Maasia, et Semeia, et Eleazar, et Azzi, et Johanan, et Melchia, et lam, et Ezer. Et clare cecinerunt cantores, et Jezraia prpositus:
kjv: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

wlc: וּמַעֲשֵׂיָה וּשְׁמַעְיָה וְאֶלְעָזָר וְעֻזִּי וִיהוֹחָנָן וּמַלְכִּיָּה וְעֵילָם וָעָזֶר וַיַּשְׁמִיעוּ הַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְיִזְרַחְיָה הַפָּקִיד ׃
vulg: et immolaverunt in die illa victimas magnas et laetati sunt Deus enim laetificaverat eos laetitia magna sed et uxores eorum et liberi gavisi sunt et audita est laetitia Hierusalem procul
clem: et immolaverunt in die illa victimas magnas, et ltati sunt: Deus enim ltificaverat eos ltitia magna: sed et uxores eorum et liberi gavisi sunt, et audita est ltitia Jerusalem procul.
kjv: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

wlc: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא זְבָחִים גְּדוֹלִים וַיִּשְׂמָחוּ כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים שִׂמְּחָם שִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה וְגַם הַנָּשִׁים וְהַיְלָדִים שָׂמֵחוּ וַתִּשָּׁמַע שִׂמְחַת יְרוּשָׁלַםִ מֵרָחוֹק ׃
vulg: recensuerunt quoque in die illa viros super gazofilacia thesauri ad libamina et ad primitias et ad decimas ut introferrent per eos principes civitatis in decore gratiarum actionis sacerdotes et Levitas quia laetatus est Iuda in sacerdotibus et Levitis adstantibus
clem: Recensuerunt quoque in die illa viros super gazophylacia thesauri ad libamina, et ad primitias, et ad decimas, ut introferrent per eos principes civitatis in decore gratiarum actionis, sacerdotes et Levitas: quia ltificatus est Juda in sacerdotibus et Levitis adstantibus.
kjv: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

wlc: וַיִּפָּקְדוּ בַיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲנָשִׁים עַל־הַנְּשָׁכוֹת לָאוֹצָרוֹת לַתְּרוּמוֹת לָרֵאשִׁית וְלַמַּעַשְׂרוֹת לִכְנוֹס בָּהֶם לִשְׂדֵי הֶעָרִים מְנָאוֹת הַתּוֹרָה לַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַלְוִיִּם כִּי שִׂמְחַת יְהוּדָה עַל־הַכֹּהֲנִים וְעַל־הַלְוִיִּם הָעֹמְדִים ׃
vulg: et custodierunt observationem Dei sui et observationem expiationis et cantores et ianitores iuxta praeceptum David et Salomonis filii eius
clem: Et custodierunt observationem Dei sui, et observationem expiationis, et cantores, et janitores juxta prceptum David, et Salomonis filii ejus,
kjv: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁמְרוּ מִשְׁמֶרֶת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת הַטָּהֳרָה וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים כְּמִצְוַת דָּוִיד שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ ׃
vulg: quia in diebus David et Asaph ab exordio erant principes constituti cantorum in carmine laudantium et confitentium Deo
clem: quia in diebus David et Asaph ab exordio erant principes constituti cantorum in carmine laudantium et confitentium Deo.
kjv: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

wlc: כִּי־בִימֵי דָוִיד וְאָסָף מִקֶּדֶם רֹאשׁ הַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְשִׁיר־תְּהִלָּה וְהֹדוֹת לֵאלֹהִים ׃
vulg: et omnis Israhel in diebus Zorobabel et in diebus Neemiae dabat partes cantoribus et ianitoribus per dies singulos et sanctificabant Levitas et Levitae sanctificabant filios Aaron
clem: Et omnis Isral in diebus Zorobabel et in diebus Nehemi, dabant partes cantoribus et janitoribus per dies singulos, et sanctificabant Levitas, et Levit sanctificabant filios Aaron.
kjv: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

wlc: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי זְרֻבָּבֶל וּבִימֵי נְחֶמְיָה נֹתְנִים מְנָיוֹת הַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ וּמַקְדִּשִׁים לַלְוִיִּם וְהַלְוִיִּם מַקְדִּשִׁים לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן ׃ פ
kjv: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.

wlc: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נִקְרָא בְּסֵפֶר מֹשֶׁה בְּאָזְנֵי הָעָם וְנִמְצָא כָּתוּב בּוֹ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָבוֹא עַמֹּנִי וּמֹאָבִי בִּקְהַל הָאֱלֹהִים עַד־עוֹלָם ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἀνέστη Ἐλεισοὺβ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τὴν πύλην τὴν προβατικήν· αὐτοὶ ἡγίασαν αὐτήν, καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς, καὶ ἕως πύργου τῶν ἑκατὸν ἡγίασαν, ἕως πύργου Ἁνανεήλ.
vulg: in die autem illo lectum est in volumine Mosi audiente populo et inventum est scriptum in eo quod non debeat introire Ammanites et Moabites in ecclesiam Dei usque in aeternum
clem: In die autem illo, lectum est in volumine Moysi, audiente populo: et inventum est scriptum in eo, quod non debeant introire Ammonites et Moabites in ecclesiam Dei usque in ternum:
kjv: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

wlc: כִּי לֹא קִדְּמוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּלֶּחֶם וּבַמָּיִם וַיִּשְׂכֹּר עָלָיו אֶת־בִּלְעָם לְקַלְלוֹ וַיַּהֲפֹךְ אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַקְּלָלָה לִבְרָכָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρας ἀνδρῶν υἱῶν Ἰερειχώ, καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρας υἱῶν Ζαβαοὺρ υἱοῦ Ἀμαρεί.
vulg: eo quod non occurrerint filiis Israhel cum pane et aqua et conduxerint adversum eum Balaam ad maledicendum ei et convertit Deus noster maledictionem in benedictionem
clem: eo quod non occurrerint filiis Isral cum pane et aqua, et conduxerint adversum eos Balaam ad maledicendum eis: et convertit Deus noster maledictionem in benedictionem.
kjv: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

wlc: וַיְהִי כְּשָׁמְעָם אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה וַיַּבְדִּילוּ כָל־עֵרֶב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ τὴν πύλην τὴν ἰχθυηρὰν οἰκοδόμησαν υἱοὶ Ἁσάν· αὐτοὶ ἐστέγασαν αὐτήν, καὶ ἐστέγασαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς.
vulg: factum est autem cum audissent legem separaverunt omnem alienigenam ab Israhel
clem: Factum est autem, cum audissent legem, separaverunt omnem alienigenam ab Isral.
kjv: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

wlc: וְלִפְנֵי מִזֶּה אֶלְיָשִׁיב הַכֹּהֵן נָתוּן בְּלִשְׁכַּת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ קָרוֹב לְטוֹבִיָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν κατέσχεν ἐπὶ Ῥαμὼθ υἱοῦ Οὐρεία υἱοῦ Ἁκώς. καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν κατέσχεν Σαδὼκ υἱὸς Βαανά.
vulg: et super hoc erat Eliasib sacerdos qui fuerat positus in gazofilacio domus Dei nostri et proximus Tobiae
clem: Et super hoc erat Eliasib sacerdos, qui fuerat prpositus in gazophylacio domus Dei nostri, et proximus Tobi.
kjv: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:

wlc: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ לִשְׁכָּה גְדוֹלָה וְשָׁם הָיוּ לְפָנִים נֹתְנִים אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה הַלְּבוֹנָה וְהַכֵּלִים וּמַעְשַׂר הַדָּגָן הַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר מִצְוַת הַלְוִיִּם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים וּתְרוּמַת הַכֹּהֲנִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν κατέσχοσαν οἱ Θεκωείν, καὶ ἀδωρηὲμ οὐκ εἰσήνεγκαν τράχηλον αὐτῶν εἰς δουλείαν αὐτῶν.
vulg: fecit ergo sibi gazofilacium grande et ibi erant ante eum reponentes munera et tus et vasa et decimam frumenti et vini et olei partes Levitarum et cantorum et ianitorum et primitias sacerdotales
clem: Fecit ergo sibi gazophylacium grande, et ibi erant ante eum reponentes munera, et thus, et vasa, et decimam frumenti, vini, et olei, partes Levitarum, et cantorum, et janitorum, et primitias sacerdotales.
kjv: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

wlc: וּבְכָל־זֶה לֹא הָיִיתִי בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ כִּי בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל בָּאתִי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְקֵץ יָמִים נִשְׁאַלְתִּי מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ τὴν πύλην Ἰσανὰ ἐκράτησαν Ἰοειαὰ υἱὸς Φασὲκ καὶ Μεσουλὰμ υἱὸς Βαδιά· αὐτοὶ ἐστέγασαν αὐτήν, καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς.
vulg: in omnibus autem his non fui in Hierusalem quia in anno tricesimo secundo Artarxersis regis Babylonis veni ad regem et in fine dierum rogavi regem
clem: In omnibus autem his non fui in Jerusalem, quia anno trigesimo secundo Artaxerxis regis Babylonis veni ad regem, et in fine dierum rogavi regem.
kjv: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

wlc: וָאָבוֹא לִירוּשָׁלִָם וָאָבִינָה בָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶלְיָשִׁיב לְטוֹבִיָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ נִשְׁכָּה בְּחַצְרֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים ׃
vulg: et veni in Hierusalem et intellexi malum quod fecerat Eliasib Tobiae ut faceret ei thesaurum in vestibulis domus Dei
clem: Et veni in Jerusalem, et intellexi malum quod fecerat Eliasib Tobi, ut faceret ei thesaurum in vestibulis domus Dei.
kjv: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

wlc: וַיֵּרַע לִי מְאֹד וָאַשְׁלִיכָה אֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵי בֵית־טוֹבִיָּה הַחוּץ מִן־הַלִּשְׁכָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν ἐκράτησαν Ἁνανίας υἱὸς τοῦ Ἰωακείμ, καὶ κατέλιπον Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἕως τείχους τοῦ πλατέως.
vulg: et malum mihi visum est valde et proieci vasa domus Tobiae foras de gazofilacio
clem: Et malum mihi visum est valde. Et projeci vasa domus Tobi foras de gazophylacio:
kjv: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff to Tobiah out of the chamber.

wlc: וָאֹמְרָה וַיְטַהֲרוּ הַלְּשָׁכוֹת וָאָשִׁיבָה שָּׁם כְּלֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וְהַלְּבוֹנָה ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν ἐκράτησεν Ῥαφαιά, ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: praecepique et mundaverunt gazofilacia et rettuli ibi vasa domus Dei sacrificium et tus
clem: prcepique et emundaverunt gazophylacia: et retuli ibi vasa domus Dei, sacrificium, et thus.
kjv: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

wlc: וָאֵדְעָה כִּי־מְנָיוֹת הַלְוִיִּם לֹא נִתָּנָה וַיִּבְרְחוּ אִישׁ־לְשָׂדֵהוּ הַלְוִיִּם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν ἐκράτησεν Ἰεδαὰ υἱὸς Ἑρωμάθ, καὶ κατέναντι οἰκίας αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Ἁτοὺθ υἱὸς Ἁσβανάμ.
vulg: et cognovi quoniam partes Levitarum non fuissent datae et fugisset unusquisque in regionem suam de Levitis et de cantoribus et de his qui ministrabant
clem: Et cognovi quod partes Levitarum non fuissent dat, et fugisset unusquisque in regionem suam de Levitis, et cantoribus, et de his qui ministrabant:
kjv: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

wlc: וָאָרִיבָה אֶת־הַסְּגָנִים וָאֹמְרָה מַדּוּעַ נֶעֱזַב בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים וָאֶקְבְּצֵם וָאַעֲמִדֵם עַל־עָמְדָם ׃
lxx: καὶ δεύτερος ἐκράτησεν Μελχείας υἱὸς Ἡρὰμ καὶ Ἁσοὺβ υἱὸς Φααβμωάβ, καὶ ἕως πύργου τῶν ναθουρείμ.
vulg: et egi causam adversus magistratus et dixi quare dereliquimus domum Dei et congregavi eos et feci stare in stationibus suis
clem: et egi causam adversus magistratus, et dixi: Quare dereliquimus domum Dei? et congregavi eos, et feci stare in stationibus suis.
kjv: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

wlc: וְכָל־יְהוּדָה הֵבִיאוּ מַעְשַׂר הַדָּגָן וְהַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר לָאוֹצָרוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Σαλοὺμ υἱὸς Ἡλειά, ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Ἰερουσαλήμ, αὐτὸς καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et omnis Iuda adportabat decimam frumenti et vini et olei in horrea
clem: Et omnis Juda apportabat decimam frumenti, vini, et olei, in horrea.
kjv: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

wlc: וָאוֹצְרָה עַל־אוֹצָרוֹת שֶׁלֶמְיָה הַכֹּהֵן וְצָדוֹק הַסּוֹפֵר וּפְדָיָה מִן־הַלְוִיִּם וְעַל־יָדָם חָנָן בֶּן־זַכּוּר בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָה כִּי נֶאֱמָנִים נֶחְשָׁבוּ וַעֲלֵיהֶם לַחֲלֹק לַאֲחֵיהֶם ׃ פ
lxx: τὴν πύλην τῆς φάραγγος ἐκράτησαν Ἁνοὺν καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ζανώ· αὐτοὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν αὐτήν, καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς, καὶ χιλίους πήχεις ἐν τῷ τείχει ἕως πύλης τῆς κοπρίας.
vulg: et constituimus super horrea Selemiam sacerdotem et Sadoc scribam et Phadaiam de Levitis et iuxta eos Anan filium Zacchur filium Matthaniae quoniam fideles conprobati sunt et ipsis creditae sunt partes fratrum suorum
clem: Et constituimus super horrea Selemiam sacerdotem, et Sadoc scribam, et Phadaiam de Levitis, et juxta eos Hanan filium Zachur, filium Mathani: quoniam fideles comprobati sunt, et ipsis credit sunt partes fratrum suorum.
kjv: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.

wlc: זָכְרָה־לִּי אֱלֹהַי עַל־זֹאת וְאַל־תֶּמַח חֲסָדַי אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי וּבְמִשְׁמָרָיו ׃
lxx: καὶ τὴν πύλην τῆς κοπρίας ἐκράτησεν Μελχειὰ υἱὸς Ῥηχάβ, ἄρχων περιχώρου Βηθαχάμ, αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐσκέπασαν αὐτήν, καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς.
vulg: memento mei Deus meus pro hoc et ne deleas miserationes meas quas feci in domo Dei mei et in caerimoniis eius
clem: Memento mei, Deus meus, pro hoc, et ne deleas miserationes meas quas feci in domo Dei mei, et in cremoniis ejus.
kjv: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

wlc: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה רָאִיתִי בִיהוּדָה דֹּרְכִים־גִּתּוֹת בַּשַּׁבָּת וּמְבִיאִים הָעֲרֵמוֹת וְעֹמְסִים עַל־הַחֲמֹרִים וְאַף־יַיִן עֲנָבִים וּתְאֵנִים וְכָל־מַשָּׂא וּמְבִיאִים יְרוּשָׁלַםִ בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת וָאָעִיד בְּיוֹם מִכְרָם צָיִד ׃
lxx: καὶ τὸ τεῖχος κολυμβήθρας τῶν κωδίων τῇ κουρᾷ τοῦ βασιλέως. καὶ ἔως τῶν κλιμάκων τῶν καταβαινουσῶν ἀπὸ πόλεως Δαυείδ.
vulg: in diebus illis vidi in Iuda calcabant torcularia in sabbato portantes acervos et onerantes super asinos vinum et uvas et ficus et omne onus et inferentes Hierusalem in die sabbati et contestatus sum ut in die qua vendere liceret venderent
clem: In diebus illis vidi in Juda calcantes torcularia in sabbato, portantes acervos, et onerantes super asinos vinum, et uvas, et ficus, et omne onus, et inferentes in Jerusalem, die sabbati. Et contestatus sum ut in die qua vendere liceret, venderent.
kjv: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

wlc: וְהַצֹּרִים יָשְׁבוּ בָהּ מְבִיאִים דָּאג וְכָל־מֶכֶר וּמֹכְרִים בַּשַּׁבָּת לִבְנֵי יְהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָם ׃
lxx: ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Νεεμίας υἱὸς Ἀζαβούχ, ἄρχων περιχώρου Βησόρ, ἕως κήπου τάφου Δαυεὶδ καὶ ἕως τῆς κολυμβήθρας τῆς γεγονυίας καὶ ἕως Βηθαβαρείμ.
vulg: et Tyrii habitaverunt in ea inferentes pisces et omnia venalia et vendebant in sabbatis filiis Iuda et in Hierusalem
clem: Et Tyrii habitaverunt in ea, inferentes pisces, et omnia venalia: et vendebant in sabbatis filiis Juda in Jerusalem.
kjv: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

wlc: וָאָרִיבָה אֵת חֹרֵי יְהוּדָה וָאֹמְרָה לָהֶם מָה־הַדָּבָר הָרָע הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹשִׂים וּמְחַלְּלִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת ׃
lxx: ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησαν οἱ Λευεῖται, Βασοὺθ υἱὸς Βανεί. ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Ἁσαβά, ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Κεειλά, τῷ περιχώρῳ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et obiurgavi optimates Iuda et dixi eis quae est res haec mala quam vos facitis et profanatis diem sabbati
clem: Et objurgavi optimates Juda, et dixi eis: Qu est hc res mala quam vos facitis, et profanatis diem sabbati?
kjv: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

wlc: הֲלוֹא כֹה עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַיָּבֵא אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ אֵת כָּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת וְעַל הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְאַתֶּם מוֹסִיפִים חָרוֹן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחַלֵּל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת ׃ פ
lxx: μετʼ αὐτὸν ἐκράτησαν ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν Βεδεὶ υἱὸς Ἡναδαλάτ, ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Κεειλά.
vulg: numquid non haec fecerunt patres nostri et adduxit Deus noster super nos omne malum hoc et super civitatem hanc et vos additis iracundiam super Israhel violando sabbatum
clem: numquid non hc fecerunt patres nostri, et adduxit Deus noster super nos omne malum hoc, et super civitatem hanc? et vos additis iracundiam super Isral violando sabbatum.
kjv: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
